issues.title: Microsoft Outage Hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot Around the World
issues.gist: A big Microsoft outage began on Thursday and lasted into Friday. Outlook, Teams and Copilot stopped working for many people around the world.

sents.en: The BBC also noted that Microsoft had reported an outage of its Azure cloud service last month.
sents.ko: BBC는 마이크로소프트가 지난달에도 클라우드 서비스 애저의 장애를 알렸다고 짚었어요.

paragraphs.en: Students and workers who use email and online meetings can see how one failure can reach many people. On Friday, Microsoft said it was seeing encouraging recovery progress. It said some people could still have problems, and it extended the email timeout to 48 hours to save delayed mail. The Verge said there was still no time for full recovery. Microsoft promised a report on the root cause after the problem is fixed.
paragraphs.ko: 금요일에는 복구가 진행됐지만 완전 복구 시점은 아직 없었고, 회사는 원인 보고서를 약속했어요.

sents.en: Students and workers who use email and online meetings can see how one failure can reach many people.
sents.ko: 이메일과 온라인 회의를 쓰는 학생과 직장인은 하나의 고장이 많은 사람에게 닿을 수 있음을 볼 수 있어요.

sents.en: On Friday, Microsoft said it was seeing encouraging recovery progress.
sents.ko: 금요일에 마이크로소프트는 복구가 순조롭게 진행되고 있다고 했어요.

sents.en: It said some people could still have problems, and it extended the email timeout to 48 hours to save delayed mail.
sents.ko: 일부 사용자는 아직 문제가 있을 수 있다고 했고, 지연된 메일을 지키려고 이메일 제한 시간을 48시간으로 늘렸어요.

sents.en: The Verge said there was still no time for full recovery.
sents.ko: 더 버지는 아직 완전 복구 시점이 없다고 했어요.

sents.en: Microsoft promised a report on the root cause after the problem is fixed.
sents.ko: 마이크로소프트는 문제가 해결되면 근본 원인 보고서를 내겠다고 약속했어요.

pro.en: Microsoft was grappling with a major global outage that began Thursday and stretched into Friday, knocking out Outlook email, Teams and the Copilot AI tool for many users. Reports of trouble began at around 1 p.m. Eastern time Thursday, according to The Verge, and Downdetector logged nearly 140,000 Outlook problem reports at the peak, the BBC said.

Microsoft said part of its infrastructure was under elevated load, and that a number of servers had become unexpectedly unavailable after failing automated checks, straining the remaining systems. The company initially had difficulty rebooting servers and monitoring their health, The Verge reported. It paused all deployments, shifted traffic off the affected infrastructure and restarted servers, while saying there was no sign of a cyber-attack.

The disruption extended well beyond Microsoft's own apps. OpenAI and Anthropic both said their connections to Microsoft services were affected. New York City warned of possible delays for people contacting city offices by email, and, the BBC said, truck maker Workhorse Group moved its earnings report from November 12 to November 16.
The BBC described the service as essential for companies that collaborate with colleagues worldwide, and noted that Microsoft had reported an outage of its Azure cloud service the previous month.

For students and workers who rely on email and online meetings, the episode showed how a single failure can reach many people. On Friday, Microsoft reported encouraging recovery progress while cautioning that some users could still face problems, and it extended the email timeout to 48 hours to preserve delayed mail. The Verge noted there was still no estimate for full recovery, and Microsoft promised a report on the root cause once the problem is fixed.

views.view: The BBC says the outage hit Teams, Outlook and Copilot, and that there was no sign of a cyber-attack.
The Verge says Outlook was still unavailable for many people and that there was no time given for full recovery.
ABC News says Microsoft saw encouraging recovery progress, though some users may still have problems.

issues.title: Trump says US does not need an Iran deal and moves Vance away from the talks
issues.gist: President Trump said the US does not need a deal with Iran. He told Vice President Vance, the lead negotiator, to focus on problems at home instead.
issues.gistKo: 트럼프 대통령이 미국은 이란과 합의가 필요 없다고 말했어요. 협상을 이끌던 밴스 부통령에게는 국내 문제에 집중하라고 했어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 미국과 이란의 전쟁을 끝내려던 협상이 더 멀어졌어요. 트럼프 대통령이 합의가 필요 없다고 하자 협상 담당자 밴스 부통령이 빠지게 됐고, 호르무즈 해협의 긴장은 계속돼요.

paragraphs.en: On Thursday, President Donald Trump wrote on social media, "We don't need a deal with Iran." He added, "Those days have long since passed." Trump also told Vice President JD Vance, who led the talks with Iran, to focus on what Trump calls corruption and crime in Democrat-run cities and states.
paragraphs.ko: 트럼프 대통령이 목요일 소셜미디어에 이란과 합의가 필요 없다고 썼어요. 이란과 협상을 이끌던 JD 밴스 부통령에게는 민주당이 이끄는 도시와 주의 부패와 범죄에 집중하라고 했어요. 부패와 범죄가 있다는 건 트럼프의 주장이에요.

sents.en: On Thursday, President Donald Trump wrote on social media, "We don't need a deal with Iran."
sents.ko: 목요일 트럼프 대통령은 소셜미디어에 "이란과의 합의는 필요 없다"고 썼어요.

sents.en: He added, "Those days have long since passed."
sents.ko: 그는 "그런 날들은 오래전에 지나갔다"고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: Trump also told Vice President JD Vance, who led the talks with Iran, to focus on what Trump calls corruption and crime in Democrat-run cities and states.
sents.ko: 트럼프는 이란 협상을 이끌던 밴스 부통령에게, 자신이 말하는 민주당 도시와 주의 부패와 범죄에 집중하라고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: The war began in February with joint American and Israeli strikes on Iran. Vance led talks in Islamabad in April, and the two sides signed a memorandum of understanding in June. pro.en: President Donald Trump declared on Thursday that "We don't need a deal with Iran," adding that "Those days have long since passed," and directed Vice President JD Vance, the administration's lead negotiator, to turn his attention to what Trump describes as corruption and crime in Democratic-run cities and states.

The war began in February with joint American-Israeli strikes, and Vance led talks in Islamabad in April that produced a memorandum of understanding in June, but negotiations have since stalled, with Tehran insisting its seven conditions be accepted and Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling them unacceptable.

Al Jazeera reported that the administration appeared divided after the Republicans' midterm defeat, in which Vance wrote on Nov. 4 that the war was the reason his party lost, while a White House official insisted that Trump "holds all the cards" and that the blockade would continue, and a Chatham House analyst described the standoff as "no war, no peace."

Tensions persisted in the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran's Revolutionary Guard said on Friday it had destroyed a U.S. early warning radar in Bahrain and Tehran said at least 12 tankers had been struck in 12 days, even as the U.S. military maintained that it was keeping open a waterway that carried one-fifth of global oil supplies in peacetime.

Because shipping through the strait can move fuel prices worldwide, attention now turns to whether talks resume and how Washington responds to Iran's seven conditions, with Trump saying he would strike again if necessary but now calling further strikes "quite unlikely".

views.view: The administration looks divided after the midterm losses, and Vance wants a deal while Trump does not think one is possible now.
Trump said no deal is needed and told Vance to focus on what he calls corruption at home, while saying he would strike again if needed.
Iran sticks to its seven conditions, Rubio calls them unacceptable, and Iran's Guard says it hit a US radar in Bahrain.
A White House official did not say if talks have ended and said Trump holds all the cards, with the naval blockade continuing.

issues.title: Democrat Scott Colom Wins a Mississippi Senate Seat and Makes History
issues.gist: Democrat Scott Colom beat Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi in a close race. He will be the state's first Black senator since the 1870s.
issues.gistKo: 민주당 스콧 콜롬이 미시시피에서 공화당 현역 상원의원 신디 하이드스미스를 근소한 차로 이겼어요. 이 주에서 1870년대 이후 처음 나온 흑인 상원의원이 돼요.
issues.easyKo: 미시시피는 공화당이 강한 주인데, 지방검사 출신 민주당 후보 콜롬이 이겼어요. 이 주는 1982년 이후 민주당 상원의원이 없었고, 150년 넘게 흑인 상원의원도 없었어요.

paragraphs.en: Democrat Scott Colom has won the U.S. Senate race in Mississippi against Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith. Colom had worked as a local district attorney. With 99 percent of the expected vote reported, he led by about 4,700 votes. ABC News put the shares at 49.2 percent for Colom and 48.7 percent for Hyde-Smith.
paragraphs.ko: 민주당의 스콧 콜롬이 미국 미시시피주 상원 선거에서 공화당 현역 신디 하이드스미스를 이겼어요. 콜롬은 지방검사였어요. 개표가 끝나 가던 11월 11일에 그는 4,400표 넘게 앞섰고, 득표율은 49.18% 대 48.72%였어요. 무소속 타이 핀킨스는 2.1%였어요.

sents.en: Colom had worked as a local district attorney.

paragraphs.en: The result is big news because of history. Mississippi last sent a Democrat to the Senate in 1982. It had not seated a Black senator since 1875. The BBC said Colom will be the third Black senator in the state's history. The first two were Hiram Revels and Blanche Bruce, who both served in the 1800s.

paragraphs.en: The BBC said a key factor was Colom's success in reaching young people and the state's large Black population. The Guardian wrote that he talked with people at hair salons, colleges and even at Trump rallies. Before the race was called, many students at Jackson State University told the BBC they had voted for the first time. One 18-year-old said she felt that change was what Mississippi needed. Headlines also said President Trump praised Colom for showing up at a rally in the state.
paragraphs.ko: BBC는 젊은 층과 이 주의 많은 흑인 유권자를 움직인 것이 승리의 중요한 요인이라고 했어요. 가디언은 콜롬이 미용실, 대학, 트럼프 집회까지 찾아다니며 사람들과 이야기했다고 전했어요. 선거 전 BBC가 만난 잭슨주립대 학생들은 처음 투표했고 변화를 바란다고 했어요. 트럼프 대통령은 콜롬이 집회에 나타난 점을 칭찬했다고 보도됐어요.

sents.en: The BBC said a key factor was Colom's success in reaching young people and the state's large Black population.
sents.ko: BBC는 젊은 층과 이 주의 많은 흑인 인구에 다가간 것이 핵심 요인이라고 했어요.

sents.en: The Guardian wrote that he talked with people at hair salons, colleges and even at Trump rallies.
sents.ko: 가디언은 그가 미용실, 대학, 심지어 트럼프 집회에서도 사람들과 이야기했다고 썼어요.

sents.en: Before the race was called, many students at Jackson State University told the BBC they had voted for the first time.
sents.ko: 결과가 나오기 전 잭슨주립대의 많은 학생들은 BBC에 처음 투표했다고 말했어요.

sents.en: One 18-year-old said she felt that change was what Mississippi needed.
sents.ko: 한 18세 학생은 미시시피에 필요한 것은 변화라고 느낀다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Headlines also said President Trump praised Colom for showing up at a rally in the state.
sents.ko: 트럼프 대통령이 이 주의 집회에 나타난 콜롬을 칭찬했다는 제목도 나왔어요.

paragraphs.en: Experts disagree on whether this win will last. An ABC News analysis asked whether his victory can create a lasting change in Mississippi politics. One result alone does not prove a trend for a whole region. For Korean students, a change in the balance of power in Congress can affect U.S. policy and relations with other countries. Next, watch what happens when the new Senate starts its work in January.
paragraphs.ko: 이 승리가 오래 가는 변화일지는 의견이 갈려요. ABC 뉴스 분석은 이것이 지속되는 정치 지형의 변화가 될 수 있는지가 문제라고 했어요. 한 번의 결과만으로 지역 전체의 흐름을 말하기는 어려워요. 한국 대학생에게는 미국 의회의 힘 균형이 바뀌면 미국의 정책과 외교에 영향이 갈 수 있다는 점이 닿아요. 다음에는 새 상원이 시작되는 1월을 지켜봐요.

sents.en: Experts disagree on whether this win will last.
sents.ko: 이 승리가 오래갈지에 대해 전문가들의 의견이 갈려요.

sents.en: An ABC News analysis asked whether his victory can create a lasting change in Mississippi politics.
sents.ko: ABC 뉴스 분석은 그의 승리가 미시시피 정치에 오래가는 변화를 만들 수 있는지 물었어요.

sents.en: One result alone does not prove a trend for a whole region.
sents.ko: 한 번의 결과로 한 지역 전체의 흐름이 증명되지는 않아요.

sents.en: For Korean students, a change in the balance of power in Congress can affect U.S. policy and relations with other countries.
sents.ko: 한국 학생에게는 의회의 힘의 균형이 바뀌면 미국의 정책과 다른 나라와의 관계가 영향을 받을 수 있다는 점이 닿아요.

sents.en: Next, watch what happens when the new Senate starts its work in January.
sents.ko: 다음에는 1월에 새 상원이 일을 시작할 때 무슨 일이 생기는지 지켜봐요.

pro.en: Democrat Scott Colom, a local district attorney, unseated Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi's U.S. Senate race, and with 99 percent of the expected vote reported, ABC News had him ahead by about 4,700 votes, 49.2 percent to 48.7 percent.

The outcome carries historic weight, as Mississippi last elected a Democratic senator in 1982 and had not seated a Black senator since 1875, and the BBC noted that Colom will become only the third Black senator in the state's history, following Hiram Revels and Blanche Bruce, both of whom served in the 19th century.

The BBC credited his success in mobilizing young people and the state's large Black population, while the Guardian reported that he courted voters at hair salons, on college campuses and at Trump rallies, and many Jackson State University students who had voted for the first time told the BBC before the race was called that they wanted change, with headlines noting that President Trump praised him for appearing at a rally.

Whether the upset signals a durable realignment remains contested, with an ABC News analysis posing it as an open question, and for Korean readers the shifting balance of power in Congress could shape U.S. policy and diplomacy, with attention turning to the new Senate when it convenes in January.

views.view: The BBC says the win is historic and credits Colom's success in reaching young people and the state's large Black population.
The Guardian describes a candidate who talked with people at hair salons, colleges and Trump rallies to win a deep-red state.
ABC News asks whether his victory can create a lasting realignment in Mississippi politics.

issues.title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Used Fake Video Calls to Steal $400 Million in Crypto
issues.gist: The US seized servers used by North Korean hackers in a video-call scam. The FBI says the scam stole more than $400 million in crypto from over 900 victims.
issues.gistKo: 미국이 북한 해커들의 영상 통화 사기에 쓰인 서버를 압수했어요. FBI는 이 사기로 900명이 넘는 피해자에게서 4억 달러 넘는 암호화폐를 훔쳤다고 해요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 아는 사람 얼굴이 나오는 가짜 화상회의로 속여서 컴퓨터에 악성 코드를 깔고 암호화폐를 훔치는 수법이에요. 미국이 그 서버를 막았지만 누구든 조심해야 해요.

paragraphs.en: The US Justice Department said it seized cloud servers used by North Korean hackers. The FBI calls the scheme "FaceStealer." It says the hackers took more than $400 million in crypto over 18 months. More than 900 people fell for the scheme, according to the FBI.
paragraphs.ko: 미국 법무부가 북한 해커들이 쓰던 클라우드 서버를 압수했다고 밝혔어요. FBI가 '페이스스틸러'라고 부르는 이 수법으로 18개월 동안 4억 달러가 넘는 암호화폐가 털렸고, 피해자는 900명이 넘는다고 해요.

sents.en: The US Justice Department said it seized cloud servers used by North Korean hackers.
sents.ko: 미국 법무부는 북한 해커들이 쓰던 클라우드 서버를 압수했다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: The FBI calls the scheme "FaceStealer."
sents.ko: FBI는 이 수법을 '페이스스틸러'라고 불러요.

sents.en: It says the hackers took more than $400 million in crypto over 18 months.
sents.ko: FBI는 해커들이 18개월 동안 4억 달러가 넘는 암호화폐를 가져갔다고 해요.

sents.en: More than 900 people fell for the scheme, according to the FBI.
sents.ko: FBI에 따르면 900명이 넘는 사람이 이 수법에 당했어요.

paragraphs.en: The hackers send meeting invites from accounts they took over. Victims join a fake call on copies of Zoom, Teams or Google Meet. The hackers play a recorded clip of an earlier victim that the target knows. Then the sound seems broken, and a message asks the target to click a link to fix it. The link installs malware on the device. The hackers then use the victim's contacts to find new targets. The FBI says they have also begun to use AI deepfakes of well-known crypto figures.
paragraphs.ko: 해커들은 탈취한 계정으로 화상회의 초대를 보내요. 가짜 회의에서 아는 사람의 녹화 영상을 틀어 믿게 만든 뒤, 소리가 고장 난 척하며 '고치기' 링크를 누르게 해 악성 코드를 깔아요.

sents.en: The hackers send meeting invites from accounts they took over.
sents.ko: 해커들은 탈취한 계정으로 회의 초대를 보내요.

sents.en: Victims join a fake call on copies of Zoom, Teams or Google Meet.
sents.ko: 피해자는 줌, 팀즈, 구글 밋을 흉내 낸 가짜 서비스의 통화에 들어가요.

sents.en: The hackers play a recorded clip of an earlier victim that the target knows.
sents.ko: 해커들은 대상이 아는 이전 피해자의 녹화 영상을 틀어요.

sents.en: Then the sound seems broken, and a message asks the target to click a link to fix it.
sents.ko: 그러면 소리가 고장 난 것처럼 보이고, 링크를 눌러 고치라는 메시지가 떠요.

sents.en: The link installs malware on the device.
sents.ko: 그 링크는 기기에 악성 코드를 깔아요.

sents.en: The hackers then use the victim's contacts to find new targets.
sents.ko: 해커들은 피해자의 연락처로 새 목표를 찾아요.

sents.en: The FBI says they have also begun to use AI deepfakes of well-known crypto figures.
sents.ko: FBI는 해커들이 유명 암호화폐 인물의 AI 딥페이크도 쓰기 시작했다고 해요.

paragraphs.en: Most targets work in crypto or other internet jobs. The hackers also go after open-source software developers. The Justice Department said this may help them attack software supply chains. FaceStealer is tied to a group called Sapphire Sleet, or UNC1069. This group is separate from the military hackers blamed for the Binance theft. Those hackers, known as TraderTraitor, took more than $6 billion around Oct. 29, the FBI said. The department also said it has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from that hack.
paragraphs.ko: 대부분의 목표는 암호화폐와 인터넷 분야 종사자예요. 이 수법은 지난달 말쯤 일어난 바이낸스 해킹과는 다른 해커 집단 소행이지만, 법무부는 그 해킹으로 빼앗긴 12억 달러 넘는 돈도 압수하거나 동결할 법원 허가를 받았다고 해요.

sents.en: Most targets work in crypto or other internet jobs.
sents.ko: 목표 대부분은 암호화폐나 다른 인터넷 분야에서 일해요.

sents.en: The hackers also go after open-source software developers.
sents.ko: 해커들은 오픈소스 소프트웨어 개발자도 노려요.

sents.en: The Justice Department said this may help them attack software supply chains.
sents.ko: 법무부는 이것이 소프트웨어 공급망 공격에 도움이 될 수 있다고 했어요.

sents.en: FaceStealer is tied to a group called Sapphire Sleet, or UNC1069.
sents.ko: 페이스스틸러는 사파이어 슬릿 또는 UNC1069라는 집단과 이어져 있어요.

sents.en: This group is separate from the military hackers blamed for the Binance theft.
sents.ko: 이 집단은 바이낸스 도난의 책임이 있다고 지목된 군 소속 해커들과는 별개예요.

sents.en: Those hackers, known as TraderTraitor, took more than $6 billion around Oct. 29, the FBI said.
sents.ko: FBI는 트레이더트레이터라는 그 해커들이 10월 29일쯤 60억 달러 넘게 가져갔다고 했어요.

sents.en: The department also said it has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from that hack.
sents.ko: 법무부는 그 해킹에서 나온 12억 달러 넘는 돈을 압수하거나 묶어 둘 법원 허가를 받았다고도 했어요.

paragraphs.en: FBI cyber director Brett Leatherman said North Korea uses stolen crypto to pay for its weapons program. North Korea has denied any part in the Binance hack. Patrick Grandy, who leads the FBI's Los Angeles office, warned that almost anyone could fall for it. BBC reported that Binance said hackers had used fake job interviews in that case. For Korean students, this shows that a friendly face on a video call may not be real. It matters for anyone who joins online interviews for internships or tech jobs.

pro.en: The US Justice Department said Thursday it had seized cloud infrastructure used by North Korean hackers in a video-call scheme the FBI calls "FaceStealer," which the bureau says has netted more than $400 million in cryptocurrency over 18 months. The FBI said more than 900 victims had fallen prey to the operation.

According to the department, the hackers issue meeting invitations from accounts hijacked from earlier victims, then lure targets onto imposter versions of Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet. They play a prerecorded clip of an acquaintance, stage an audio malfunction and prompt the target to click a link that installs malware. The stolen contact lists then supply fresh targets, and the FBI said the group has begun experimenting with AI-generated deepfakes of prominent crypto figures.

Most targets work in crypto and other internet-related fields, and the hackers are increasingly pursuing open-source software developers, apparently to enable supply-chain attacks, the department said. The FBI links FaceStealer to a cluster known as Sapphire Sleet, or UNC1069, which is distinct from the military hackers, known as TraderTraitor, that it blamed for stealing more than $6 billion around Oct. 29. The department also obtained court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion taken in that breach.

FBI cyber director Brett Leatherman said Pyongyang relies on large-scale crypto theft to fund its illicit weapons program, while North Korea has denied involvement in the Binance hack. Patrick Grandy, head of the bureau's Los Angeles field office, cautioned that anyone confident they could never be fooled was not thinking creatively enough. The BBC reported that Binance had said hackers used fake job interviews in that case.

Authorities typically file a forfeiture claim in court, after which a judge determines who holds a rightful claim to recovered funds. How the court handles the $1.2 billion claim is likely to be the next development to watch.

pro.en: North Korea has altered the proportions of its national flag for the first time since the state's founding in 1948. The revision appears in an amended constitution posted Friday on Naenara, Pyongyang's propaganda website. Article 166 sets the ratio of the flag's height to its width at 1 to 1.65, replacing the previous ratio of 1 to 2.

The flag's overall design remains intact, with a broad red stripe at the center, narrow white and blue stripes above and below it, and a red five-pointed star inside a white circle. The constitution describes the red stripe as representing the blood shed by fighters against Japan's colonial rule from 1910 to 1945. It says the white parts symbolize loyalty to the leader and the ruling Workers' Party, while the blue stripes stand for peace, friendship and the country's sovereignty. The 1-to-2 ratio had remained in the law until the constitutional revision of September 2023.

Yonhap News Agency reported that observers believe the revision may reflect efforts to craft a new national image under Kim Jong-un, the third-generation ruler. Korea Herald said analysts regard it as another step in his drive to forge an identity distinct from his predecessors. They tie it to his "two hostile states" doctrine, which treats North and South Korea as separate, adversarial countries. Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University, said the revision balances continuity with earlier leaders' legacies and a distinct identity under Kim. He said it matters for institutionalizing the doctrine in the constitution and in national symbols.

The move follows other symbolic changes. In 2024, Pyongyang revised its anthem, replacing a term for the entire Korean Peninsula with a phrase meaning "this world." Earlier in 2026, the regime stripped provisions on reunification from its constitution.

For South Korean readers, the flag change underscores Pyongyang's shift away from the idea of a single Korean nation. Whether it extends the revision to other national symbols or laws remains to be seen.

pro.en: Netflix and AEG Presents have unveiled the KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour, which will launch in June 2027 and ultimately take in nearly 50 cities, with more than 150 performances spread across 2027 and 2028.

The production will combine animation with live performers, stunts and choreography, as HUNTR/X members Rumi, Mira and Zoey interact with audiences alongside the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger, and fans help seal the Honmoon, the barrier that shields their world. One outlet noted that how the animated characters will be presented on stage has not yet been disclosed.

A Mastercard presale opens on Nov. 18, followed by a fan presale on Nov. 19 and a general on-sale on Nov. 20, each at 10 a.m. local time. The UK leg takes in Glasgow, Birmingham, Manchester and London in October, with a three-show run at London's O2 closing out the 2027 schedule.

The film has become Netflix's most-watched movie ever, drawing more than 670 million views, and its hit song 'Golden' became the first K-pop track to win both an Oscar and a Grammy. Netflix chief marketing officer Marian Lee said the fandom was never about a single moment.

Dates for Asia Pacific and Latin America are still to be announced, and fans who register on the official tour website can gain access to the fan presale. Observers will be watching for additional cities to be added.

issues.title: Google Meets Korea's Security Rules for High-Precision Map Data
issues.gist: South Korea says Google has met the security conditions for using its detailed map data. This may bring more competition to the map app market.
issues.gistKo: 한국 정부가 구글이 정밀 지도 데이터의 보안 조건을 충족했다고 밝혔어요. 국내 지도 앱 시장에 경쟁이 더 커질 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: The South Korean government said on Friday that Google has met the security rules for using Korea's detailed map data. In February, Korea gave Google a conditional approval to send this map data abroad. The map is very detailed, at a scale of 1 to 5,000. The conditions covered coordinates, satellite images, data processing and how to respond to security problems. A group of officials and private experts checked Google's work and found that it met the conditions.

sents.ko: 모바일인덱스에 따르면 네이버 지도가 10월 월간 이용자 3,120만 명으로 가장 많이 쓰여요.

sents.ko: 대학생에게는 도시에서 길을 찾을 때 고를 수 있는 앱이 하나 더 늘어날 수 있다는 뜻이에요.

paragraphs.en: The next step is for Google to receive the processed images and put them in its maps. KBS said Google may expand its services in Korea as early as the beginning of next year.
paragraphs.ko: 다음으로 구글이 보안 처리된 사진을 받아 교체하는지가 관건이에요. KBS는 이르면 내년 초 서비스가 넓어질 수 있다고 전했어요.

sents.en: The next step is for Google to receive the processed images and put them in its maps.
sents.ko: 다음 단계는 구글이 처리된 사진을 받아 지도에 넣는 일이에요.

sents.en: KBS said Google may expand its services in Korea as early as the beginning of next year.
sents.ko: KBS는 구글이 이르면 내년 초 한국에서 서비스를 넓힐 수 있다고 전했어요.

pro.en: South Korea's government said Friday that Google had satisfied the security conditions attached to its conditional February approval to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data, after a consultative body of officials and private experts reviewed the company's implementation. The conditions covered coordinates, satellite imagery, data processing and security-incident response.

Google stripped the longitude and latitude of Korean territory from Google Maps and Google Earth, built a Korea-specific control layer that blocks app updates exposing restricted coordinates, and signed a deal on Aug. 31 to obtain satellite imagery that the National Geographic Information Institute has processed for security purposes. TMAP Mobility, a local partner, is to process the base map data, and Google must swap in the images unaltered once it receives them.

The company also deleted Street View imagery of the interiors of military and security facilities and of roads within 50 meters of their boundaries, and it named the president of Google Korea as its domestic map officer, backed by a team that must complete any needed fix within one business day. The data is limited to basic map and road network information, with users' personal and location data excluded. The government will monitor compliance and may revoke the approval in the event of serious violations.

Yonhap said the outcome is expected to heat up competition in the local map app market, where Naver Map leads with 31.2 million monthly active users in October, according to Mobile Index, ahead of TMAP at 15.1 million, Kakao Map at 13.8 million and Google Maps at 10.5 million. For students, that could mean one more option for navigating the city.

The next step is for Google to receive the security-processed imagery and place it in its maps, and KBS reported that the company could widen its services in Korea as early as the beginning of next year.

views.view: The review is expected to heat up competition in the local map app market.
Google could expand its services in Korea early next year, and AI and navigation could reshape the market.
Google must answer government requests within one business day, and the approval can be revoked if conditions are broken.

issues.title: South Korea holds its own memorial for Sado mine workers for a third year as the dispute with Japan goes on
issues.gist: South Korea held its own memorial on Nov. 13 for Koreans forced to work at Japan’s Sado mines. It was the third year in a row, because the two countries still disagree on how to describe the history.
issues.gistKo: 한국 정부가 11월 13일 일본 사도광산에서 강제로 일한 조선인들을 위한 추도식을 따로 열었어요. 두 나라가 그 역사를 어떻게 말할지 여전히 달라서, 3년 연속 따로 열렸어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 일본이 세계유산 등재 때 한 약속을 두고 두 나라 생각이 아직 달라요. 한국은 강제 동원이었다고 말하고 싶어 하고, 일본은 그 말을 쓰지 않아서 추도식을 따로 열고 있어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea held its own memorial on Friday, Nov. 13, for Korean workers who were forced to labor at Japan’s Sado mines. The event took place at a hotel on Sado Island in Niigata Prefecture. Ambassador Lee Hyuk gave a speech, and nine family members of the victims attended. Last year, eleven family members came. It was the third year in a row that Seoul held a separate event.
paragraphs.ko: 11월 13일 금요일, 한국 정부가 일본 니가타현 사도섬의 한 호텔에서 추도식을 따로 열었어요. 이혁 주일 대사가 연설했고 유족 9명이 참석했어요. 3년 연속이에요.

sents.en: South Korea held its own memorial on Friday, Nov. 13, for Korean workers who were forced to labor at Japan’s Sado mines.
sents.ko: 한국은 11월 13일 금요일, 일본 사도광산에서 강제로 일한 조선인 노동자들을 위한 추도식을 따로 열었어요.

sents.ko: 행사는 니가타현 사도섬의 한 호텔에서 열렸어요.

sents.ko: 이혁 대사가 연설했고, 희생자 유족 9명이 참석했어요.

paragraphs.en: More than 1,500 Koreans were sent to work at the mine during Japan’s rule of Korea from 1910 to 1945. Many did dangerous work underground, and some died in accidents, according to historical records and officials. In 2024, Japan asked Seoul to support putting the mine on the UNESCO World Heritage list. The two countries agreed to hold a memorial at the site every year. But Tokyo has not accepted that the Koreans were forced to work, so Seoul now holds its own event.
paragraphs.ko: 일제강점기에 1,500명이 넘는 조선인이 이 광산에 동원됐고, 위험한 지하 작업을 한 사람이 많았어요. 2024년 세계유산 등재 때 두 나라는 해마다 추도식을 열기로 했지만 일본이 강제성을 인정하지 않아 한국이 따로 열고 있어요.

sents.en: Many did dangerous work underground, and some died in accidents, according to historical records and officials.

paragraphs.en: In his speech, Lee said many Korean workers were taken to the island against their will. He said that remembering past pain would help bring understanding and healing. Japan held its own ceremony on Sept. 12. KBS said that, as in earlier years, the Japanese event did not mention forced labor. paragraphs.en: In July 2026, the UNESCO World Heritage Committee asked Japan to explain more clearly how the site shows its “whole history.” That history includes the time when Korean workers were forced to come. The committee also asked Japan to send a follow-up report by December 2027. For Korean students, this is an example of how history, memory, and diplomacy are tied together.

pro.en: South Korea staged a separate memorial on Friday for Koreans who were made to labor at Japan’s Sado mine complex, marking the third consecutive year that Seoul has held its own event rather than join a Japanese-organized one. Ambassador Lee Hyuk addressed the gathering at a hotel on Sado Island in Niigata Prefecture, where nine relatives of the victims were present, compared with 11 last year.

More than 1,500 Koreans were mobilized to work at the mine during Japan’s 1910-45 colonial rule of the peninsula, many of them assigned to hazardous underground tasks, and some died in accidents, according to historical records and officials. When Tokyo sought Seoul’s cooperation for the site’s 2024 UNESCO World Heritage listing, the two governments agreed to hold annual memorials there, yet Japan has declined to acknowledge the coercive nature of the wartime mobilization, prompting Seoul to go its own way.

In his address, Lee said many Korean laborers were taken to the island against their will, and he argued that remembering past suffering would foster empathy and healing. Japan held its own ceremony on Sept. 12, at which, as in earlier years, forced labor went unmentioned, KBS reported; the Korea Herald said Yukiya Hamamoto, a Japanese Foreign Ministry official, acknowledged dangerous and harsh conditions for the workers but stopped short of saying they were forced.

The UNESCO World Heritage Committee, in a decision adopted in July 2026, urged Japan to clarify further how the site’s interpretation reflects its “whole history,” including the period when Korean workers were forcibly mobilized, and to submit a follow-up implementation report by December 2027.

Three years after Tokyo’s commitment, the two sides have yet to agree on a joint ceremony, and they remain at odds over the event’s official name and the wording of the remarks. Attention now turns to Japan’s report to UNESCO, due by December 2027, and to whether the governments can settle on a ceremony next year.

views.view: Yonhap says Seoul called on Japan to face the full history, and notes that Tokyo has refused to admit the work was forced.
The Korea Herald says a Japanese official spoke of harsh conditions but did not clearly say the labor was forced, which is the main point of the dispute.
KBS says Japan’s own ceremony in September again made no mention of forced labor.
The Korea Times adds that a UNESCO committee asked Japan to explain the whole history and report back by December 2027.

pro.en: Aespa unveiled a reworked rendition of the Christmas standard "Santa Baby" on Friday, according to SM Entertainment, the group's label; the song was first released in 1953.
The project commemorates the centenary of the birth of American singer and songwriter Eartha Kitt, and some outlets reported that the new track features her original vocals.
Speaking through the label, the quartet said all four members have listened to the song at the end of every year and that adding their own color to a number so long cherished felt special.

Separately, the group is set to release on Nov. 20 a remix of "Kiss N Tell", the main track from its first Japanese EP, featuring Japanese DJ and producer Taku Takahashi; the mini album of the same title, released in July, topped Oricon's daily charts.
Listeners seeking a seasonal soundtrack can sample the new carol now, and attention turns next to the Nov. 20 remix.

views.view: Aespa gave the old carol a new spin to mark 100 years since Eartha Kitt's birth, and the members said the work felt special.

pro.en: Science and ICT Minister Bae Kyung-hoon said Friday that Nvidia had reaffirmed its commitment to deploy up to 260,000 graphics processing units in South Korea, seeking to calm concerns raised by the abrupt resignation of chief executive Jensen Huang, in a Facebook post.

Nvidia unveiled the supply plan in October to build large-scale AI factories in the country, and Samsung Electronics, SK Group, Hyundai Motor Group and Naver Cloud are each expected to set up their own computing centers powered by the company's latest Blackwell chips, which are designed to handle vast numbers of calculations simultaneously.

The minister said the government's separate initiative to secure 50,000 GPUs was proceeding on schedule, with about 21,000 of the roughly 35,000 units to be obtained directly from Nvidia already in hand and the remainder due by early next year.

Bae added that other joint projects would continue, including efforts to link domestically produced AI semiconductors with Nvidia platforms through its NVLink technology, though local media reported that SK hynix shares tumbled more than 3 percent and Seoul equities slipped amid the uncertainty.

The outcome carries weight for a country whose economy leans heavily on chips and AI, and for graduates seeking jobs at those firms, with attention now turning to the timing of the chip deliveries and any change in Nvidia's leadership.

pro.en: President Lee Jae Myung on Friday visited the Korea Exchange in Seoul and reaffirmed his pledge to pursue capital market reform, attending a policy meeting with experts, corporate representatives and government officials. He described the undervaluation of Korean stocks as an unreasonable abnormality, a day after telling his senior aides that the market remains an attractive investment destination.

Lee spoke amid pronounced volatility: the benchmark KOSPI reached an all-time closing high of 9,114.55 points in late June, closed at 5,342.73 on Thursday and traded in the mid-5,000 range on Friday. He said the market had been significantly affected by recent external uncertainties, given solid economic fundamentals, and said investors fear another geopolitical crisis along the ceasefire line.

Lee said the government had introduced reforms targeting unfair trading and abuses by major shareholders but that much work remained, and that he had instructed an investigative body to crack down on stock price manipulation. He also urged policies to ease mergers and acquisitions, calling hostile takeovers the greatest tool for normalizing the market and a means of expanding the overall pie, and proposed a high-level body to oversee the reforms.

On Thursday, Lee told aides that a fairly valued capital market should translate into greater household wealth and better livelihoods, and he called for measures to improve corporate valuations, raise shareholder returns and attract long-term investment. Retail investors, including students with modest portfolios, are directly exposed to the index swings that prompted his remarks.

Details of the planned rules have yet to emerge. Observers will watch whether the government establishes the high-level oversight body, what measures on takeovers follow, and whether the KOSPI recovers from its mid-5,000 range.

issues.title: Korean Air Will Fly Daily from Seoul to Newark Starting in May 2027
issues.gist: Korean Air will start daily nonstop flights between Seoul and Newark on May 22, 2027. It will be the airline's first Newark service in more than 25 years.
issues.gistKo: 대한항공이 2027년 5월 22일부터 서울과 뉴어크를 잇는 직항을 매일 운항해요. 25년 넘게 쉬었던 뉴어크 노선이 다시 열리는 거예요.
issues.easyKo: 대한항공이 뉴욕 근처 뉴어크 공항으로 가는 직항을 2027년 5월부터 매일 띄워요. 이미 뉴욕 JFK 공항에 가고 있지만, 뉴저지 쪽으로 가는 새 선택지가 생겨요.

paragraphs.en: Korean Air will start daily flights between Seoul and Newark, New Jersey, on May 22, 2027. Newark will be the airline's second airport in the New York area. The company already flies to John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York.
paragraphs.ko: 대한항공이 2027년 5월 22일부터 서울과 뉴저지 뉴어크를 매일 잇는 직항을 시작해요. 뉴어크는 뉴욕 일대에서 두 번째 취항 공항이에요.

sents.en: Korean Air will start daily flights between Seoul and Newark, New Jersey, on May 22, 2027.
sents.ko: 대한항공은 2027년 5월 22일부터 서울과 뉴저지 뉴어크를 잇는 항공편을 매일 띄우기 시작해요.

sents.en: Newark will be the airline's second airport in the New York area.
sents.ko: 뉴어크는 이 항공사가 뉴욕 일대에서 쓰는 두 번째 공항이 돼요.

sents.en: The company already flies to John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York.
sents.ko: 이 회사는 이미 뉴욕의 존 F. 케네디 국제공항으로 가고 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Flight KE97 leaves Incheon at 10:00 p.m. and lands in Newark at 11:00 p.m. local time. The return flight, KE98, leaves Newark at 1:00 a.m. and reaches Incheon at 5:15 a.m. the next day. The trip takes about 14 hours going out and about 15 hours and 15 minutes coming back. Korean Air will use a Boeing 777-300ER with 277 seats. There will be eight first class seats, 42 business class seats and 227 economy seats.
paragraphs.ko: KE97은 밤 10시에 인천을 떠나 같은 날 밤 11시에 뉴어크에 닿고, 돌아오는 KE98은 새벽 1시에 출발해요. 보잉 777-300ER, 277석이에요.

sents.en: Flight KE97 leaves Incheon at 10:00 p.m. and lands in Newark at 11:00 p.m. local time.
sents.ko: KE97편은 밤 10시에 인천을 떠나 현지 시간 밤 11시에 뉴어크에 내려요.

sents.en: The return flight, KE98, leaves Newark at 1:00 a.m. and reaches Incheon at 5:15 a.m. the next day.
sents.ko: 돌아오는 KE98편은 새벽 1시에 뉴어크를 떠나 다음 날 아침 5시 15분에 인천에 닿아요.

sents.en: The trip takes about 14 hours going out and about 15 hours and 15 minutes coming back.
sents.ko: 가는 데 약 14시간, 오는 데 약 15시간 15분이 걸려요.

sents.en: Korean Air will use a Boeing 777-300ER with 277 seats.
sents.ko: 대한항공은 277석짜리 보잉 777-300ER를 쓸 거예요.

sents.en: There will be eight first class seats, 42 business class seats and 227 economy seats.
sents.ko: 일등석 8석, 비즈니스석 42석, 일반석 227석이에요.

paragraphs.en: Korean Air flew to Newark before, but it stopped in September 2001 after the 9/11 attacks. It did not bring the route back, so the gap lasts more than 25 years. United Airlines began its first nonstop flight from Newark to Incheon in September. The Korean airline Air Premia also flies this route. So Korean Air will be the third airline on the Incheon-Newark market.
paragraphs.ko: 대한항공은 2001년 9월 9·11 테러 뒤 뉴어크 운항을 멈췄고 다시 열지 않았어요. 지금은 유나이티드항공과 에어프레미아가 이 노선을 다니니 세 번째 항공사가 돼요.

sents.en: Korean Air flew to Newark before, but it stopped in September 2001 after the 9/11 attacks.
sents.ko: 대한항공은 전에도 뉴어크에 갔지만 2001년 9월 9·11 테러 뒤 멈췄어요.

sents.en: It did not bring the route back, so the gap lasts more than 25 years.
sents.ko: 그 노선을 되살리지 않아서 공백이 25년 넘게 이어졌어요.

sents.en: United Airlines began its first nonstop flight from Newark to Incheon in September.
sents.ko: 유나이티드항공은 9월에 뉴어크에서 인천으로 가는 첫 직항을 시작했어요.

sents.en: The Korean airline Air Premia also flies this route.
sents.ko: 한국 항공사 에어프레미아도 이 노선을 운항해요.

sents.en: So Korean Air will be the third airline on the Incheon-Newark market.
sents.ko: 그래서 대한항공은 인천-뉴어크 시장의 세 번째 항공사가 돼요.

paragraphs.en: The news comes as Korean Air finishes its merger with Asiana Airlines. It plans to finish joining Asiana's customer services on Dec. 17. Korean Air also works closely with Delta Air Lines, so the Newark flight creates a new connection for travelers. Newark is a good gateway to New Jersey and nearby parts of Pennsylvania. The first flight is still months away, so the plans could change.
paragraphs.ko: 이번 발표는 대한항공이 아시아나항공과의 합병을 마무리하는 때에 나왔어요. 델타항공과 손잡은 사이라 새 연결도 생겨요. 아직 출발까지 시간이 남아 있어서 계획이 바뀔 수도 있어요.

sents.en: The news comes as Korean Air finishes its merger with Asiana Airlines.
sents.ko: 이 소식은 대한항공이 아시아나항공과의 합병을 마무리하는 때에 나왔어요.

sents.en: It plans to finish joining Asiana's customer services on Dec. 17.
sents.ko: 대한항공은 12월 17일에 아시아나의 고객 서비스 통합을 끝낼 계획이에요.

sents.en: Korean Air also works closely with Delta Air Lines, so the Newark flight creates a new connection for travelers.
sents.ko: 대한항공은 델타항공과 긴밀히 협력해서 뉴어크 노선이 여행객에게 새 연결을 만들어요.

sents.en: Newark is a good gateway to New Jersey and nearby parts of Pennsylvania.
sents.ko: 뉴어크는 뉴저지와 펜실베이니아 인근으로 가기 좋은 관문이에요.

sents.en: The first flight is still months away, so the plans could change.
sents.ko: 첫 비행까지 아직 몇 달 남아서 계획이 바뀔 수 있어요.

pro.en: Korean Air said it will launch daily nonstop service between Seoul's Incheon airport and Newark Liberty International Airport in New Jersey on May 22, 2027, adding a second New York-area gateway alongside its long-standing service to John F. Kennedy International Airport.

Flight KE97 is scheduled to depart Incheon at 10:00 p.m. and arrive in Newark at 11:00 p.m. local time, while KE98 will leave Newark at 1:00 a.m. and land in Incheon at 5:15 a.m. the following day, with block times of roughly 14 hours outbound and 15 hours and 15 minutes inbound, aboard a 277-seat Boeing 777-300ER configured with eight first class, 42 business class and 227 economy seats.

The carrier previously served Newark until it suspended flights in September 2001 following the 9/11 attacks and never restored them, an absence of more than 25 years, and it will now compete with United Airlines, which started its first Newark-Incheon nonstop in September, and with the South Korean carrier Air Premia.

The announcement comes as Korean Air wraps up its merger with Asiana Airlines, with customer-facing integration due to be completed on Dec. 17, and it gives the carrier a new link with its joint venture partner Delta Air Lines, although the schedule remains subject to change before launch.

issues.title: Hyundai Motor Teams Up With Socar and Apex Mobility to Collect Korean Road Data for Self-Driving Cars
issues.gist: Hyundai Motor signed a deal with Socar and Apex Mobility. They will work together on self-driving car platforms and collect driving data in South Korea.
issues.gistKo: 현대자동차가 쏘카, 에이펙스 모빌리티와 손잡았어요. 세 회사는 자율주행 차량 플랫폼을 함께 만들고 국내 주행 데이터를 모을 거예요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 현대차가 차와 개발 장비를 빌려주고 쏘카 쪽이 한국 도로에서 달린 기록을 모아서, 한국 도로에 맞는 자율주행을 만들겠다는 뜻이에요.

paragraphs.en: Hyundai Motor said on Friday that it will work with Socar and Apex Mobility on self-driving cars. The three companies signed a memorandum of understanding, or MOU, at Socar's headquarters in Seoul. The deal covers self-driving vehicle platforms and the collection of driving data in South Korea.
paragraphs.ko: 현대차가 13일 쏘카, 에이펙스 모빌리티와 협력하기로 했어요. 서울 쏘카 본사에서 업무협약을 맺었고, 자율주행 차량 플랫폼 개발과 국내 주행 데이터 수집이 내용이에요.

sents.en: Hyundai Motor said on Friday that it will work with Socar and Apex Mobility on self-driving cars.
sents.ko: 현대차는 금요일에 쏘카, 에이펙스 모빌리티와 자율주행차 분야에서 협력한다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: The three companies signed a memorandum of understanding, or MOU, at Socar's headquarters in Seoul.
sents.ko: 세 회사는 서울 쏘카 본사에서 업무협약(MOU)을 맺었어요.

sents.en: The deal covers self-driving vehicle platforms and the collection of driving data in South Korea.
sents.ko: 협약에는 자율주행 차량 플랫폼과 국내 주행 데이터 수집이 담겼어요.

paragraphs.en: Hyundai Motor will supply vehicles to Socar and Apex Mobility. It will also give them its DevKit, a system that lets self-driving technology be added to a car. Socar and the game company Krafton set up Apex Mobility in May. This startup collects and processes real road data to train artificial intelligence, or AI.
paragraphs.ko: 현대차는 쏘카와 에이펙스 모빌리티에 차량과 개발 시스템 데브킷을 공급해요. 에이펙스 모빌리티는 5월에 쏘카와 게임사 크래프톤이 세운 회사로, 실제 도로 데이터를 모아 AI 학습에 써요.

sents.en: Hyundai Motor will supply vehicles to Socar and Apex Mobility.
sents.ko: 현대차는 쏘카와 에이펙스 모빌리티에 차량을 공급할 거예요.

sents.en: It will also give them its DevKit, a system that lets self-driving technology be added to a car.
sents.ko: 자율주행 기술을 차에 넣을 수 있게 해 주는 시스템인 데브킷도 제공해요.

sents.en: Socar and the game company Krafton set up Apex Mobility in May.
sents.ko: 쏘카와 게임 회사 크래프톤은 5월에 에이펙스 모빌리티를 세웠어요.

sents.en: This startup collects and processes real road data to train artificial intelligence, or AI.
sents.ko: 이 스타트업은 인공지능(AI)을 학습시키려고 실제 도로 데이터를 모으고 가공해요.

paragraphs.en: The three companies will collect and study Korean road and traffic conditions. Hyundai Motor says the goal is self-driving technology that fits local driving conditions.
paragraphs.ko: 세 회사는 한국의 도로와 교통 상황을 모으고 분석해요. 현대차는 한국 주행 환경에 맞는 자율주행 기술을 만드는 것이 목표라고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: The three companies will collect and study Korean road and traffic conditions.
sents.ko: 세 회사는 한국의 도로와 교통 상황 데이터를 모으고 연구할 거예요.

sents.en: Hyundai Motor says the goal is self-driving technology that fits local driving conditions.
sents.ko: 현대차는 한국 주행 환경에 맞는 자율주행 기술이 목표라고 말해요.

paragraphs.en: Yoo Ji-han of Hyundai Motor Group and Park Jae-wook, CEO of Socar and Apex Mobility, signed the agreement. Yoo is the vice president in charge of software-defined vehicle platforms. Apex Mobility plans to launch robotaxi and autonomous bus services one day.
paragraphs.ko: 협약서에는 현대차그룹의 유지한 부사장과 쏘카·에이펙스 모빌리티 박재욱 대표가 서명했어요. 에이펙스 모빌리티는 언젠가 로보택시와 자율주행 버스를 상업 운행할 계획이에요.

sents.en: Yoo Ji-han of Hyundai Motor Group and Park Jae-wook, CEO of Socar and Apex Mobility, signed the agreement.
sents.ko: 현대차그룹의 유지한 부사장과 쏘카·에이펙스 모빌리티의 박재욱 대표가 협약에 서명했어요.

sents.en: Yoo is the vice president in charge of software-defined vehicle platforms.
sents.ko: 유 부사장은 소프트웨어 중심 차량(SDV) 플랫폼을 맡고 있어요.

sents.en: Apex Mobility plans to launch robotaxi and autonomous bus services one day.
sents.ko: 에이펙스 모빌리티는 언젠가 로보택시와 자율주행 버스 서비스를 시작할 계획이에요.

pro.en: Hyundai Motor has agreed to pool resources with Socar, the car-sharing operator, and Apex Mobility, its autonomous-driving affiliate, formalizing a memorandum of understanding on Friday at Socar's Seoul headquarters. The accord centers on co-developing self-driving vehicle platforms and accumulating driving data inside South Korea.

Hyundai Motor is to furnish both partners with vehicles and with its DevKit, a development system designed to let autonomous-driving technology be built into cars. Apex Mobility, launched in May by Socar and the gaming company Krafton, concentrates on gathering and processing real-world road data that is used to train artificial intelligence.
According to Hyundai Motor, the trio will gather and examine the nation's road and traffic conditions, with the objective of producing driving technology suited to the local environment.

The agreement was signed by Yoo Ji-han, a Hyundai Motor Group vice president overseeing software-defined vehicle platforms, and Park Jae-wook, who serves as chief executive of both Socar and Apex Mobility, a startup that aims in time to introduce commercial robotaxi and autonomous bus services.

issues.title: Coachella 2027 Lineup Names Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA, With Several K-pop Acts
issues.gist: Coachella shared its 2027 lineup. Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA are the main headliners, and Jisoo, NCT and BABYMONSTER are also on the bill.
issues.gistKo: 코첼라가 2027년 출연진을 공개했어요. 두아 리파, 테임 임팔라, SZA가 간판 출연자고, 지수·NCT·베이비몬스터도 무대에 올라요.

sents.en: Coachella, a big music festival in California, shared its 2027 lineup on November 11.

sents.en: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA will be the main headliners.
sents.ko: 두아 리파, 테임 임팔라, SZA가 주요 헤드라이너예요.

sents.en: Daddy Yankee is the fourth headliner on the bill.
sents.ko: 대디 양키가 네 번째 헤드라이너로 이름을 올렸어요.

sents.en: The festival will be held in the Indio desert from April 9 to 11 and April 16 to 18.

Dua Lipa and SZA have both appeared before, but this is their first time headlining on their own. Madonna will play the Dance Tent for the second year in a row. She said on Instagram that she will bring a brand-new show and new music.

paragraphs.en: Several Korean acts will join the festival too. BLACKPINK's Jisoo is on the Friday lineup, NCT is set for Saturdays, and BABYMONSTER will play on Sundays. NCT 127 and NCT DREAM confirmed their spots on Instagram Stories. DJ Peggy Gou and the pansori pop band LEENALCHI will also play on Fridays.

sents.en: Passes go on sale this Friday at noon Pacific time.
sents.ko: 입장권은 이번 금요일 정오(태평양 시간)에 판매를 시작해요.

sents.ko: 아메리칸 익스프레스 사전 판매는 24시간 먼저 시작해요.

sents.en: The festival will again stream on YouTube.
sents.ko: 축제는 올해도 유튜브로 중계돼요.

pro.en: Coachella organizers on Nov. 11 unveiled the 2027 lineup, naming Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA as headliners, with Daddy Yankee in the fourth headlining slot. The festival returns to the Indio desert on April 9-11 and April 16-18.

Madonna, Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer and Don Toliver round out the marquee names on the bill. Kevin Parker headlined in 2019, becoming the first Australian artist to do so, while Dua Lipa and SZA will top the festival in their own right for the first time. Madonna returns to the Dance Tent for a second consecutive year and has promised, in an Instagram post, a brand-new show and new music.

Korean acts feature prominently, with Jisoo of BLACKPINK on the Friday bill, NCT on Saturdays and BABYMONSTER on Sundays. NCT 127 and NCT DREAM confirmed their attendance through Instagram Stories, while DJ Peggy Gou and the pansori pop band LEENALCHI will also take the stage on Fridays.

Pitchfork characterized much of the bill as a typically eclectic mix, while Soompi, which covers K-pop, highlighted the Korean contingent and asked readers whether they were excited. Passes go on sale Friday at noon Pacific time, preceded 24 hours earlier by an American Express presale, and the festival will again be streamed on YouTube.

issues.title: Samsung Starts Building a 46 Trillion Won HBM Chip Packaging Plant in Onyang
issues.gist: Samsung broke ground on a new chip plant in Onyang on Nov. 12. The company will invest 46 trillion won to build five lines for HBM, a key memory chip for AI.
issues.gistKo: 삼성전자가 11월 12일 온양에서 새 반도체 공장 기공식을 열었어요. AI에 꼭 필요한 메모리인 HBM 생산 라인 다섯 개에 46조 원을 투자해요.
issues.easyKo: 삼성전자가 충청남도 온양 사업장을 AI용 메모리 HBM을 만드는 큰 기지로 바꾸려고 해요. 새 공장은 2028년 6월에 가동할 계획이고, 직접 일자리 약 700개가 생길 것으로 봐요.

paragraphs.en: Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong spoke at a groundbreaking ceremony in Onyang on Nov. 12. Onyang is a city in South Chungcheong Province, and Samsung already runs chip operations there. He said the site will become a major hub for advanced chip packaging, including high-bandwidth memory, or HBM. HBM is a memory chip that is key for AI chips.
paragraphs.ko: 삼성전자 이재용 회장이 11월 12일 온양에서 열린 기공식에서 이곳을 첨단 반도체 패키징, 특히 HBM의 중심지로 만들겠다고 말했어요. 온양은 충청남도에 있는 도시예요.

sents.en: Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong spoke at a groundbreaking ceremony in Onyang on Nov. 12.
sents.ko: 삼성전자 이재용 회장이 11월 12일 온양 기공식에서 말했어요.

sents.en: Onyang is a city in South Chungcheong Province, and Samsung already runs chip operations there.
sents.ko: 온양은 충청남도에 있는 도시이고, 삼성은 이미 그곳에서 반도체 사업을 하고 있어요.

sents.en: He said the site will become a major hub for advanced chip packaging, including high-bandwidth memory, or HBM.
sents.ko: 그는 이곳이 고대역폭 메모리(HBM)를 포함한 첨단 칩 패키징의 중심지가 될 것이라고 했어요.

sents.en: HBM is a memory chip that is key for AI chips.
sents.ko: HBM은 AI 반도체에 꼭 필요한 메모리 칩이에요.

paragraphs.en: Samsung plans to invest a total of 46 trillion won, or about $34.5 billion, in the campus. The money will pay for five HBM production lines. About 6 trillion won will go to construction, and 40 trillion won will go to advanced equipment. The equipment will be installed in phases.
paragraphs.ko: 삼성은 이 사업장에 모두 46조 원(약 345억 달러)을 투자해 HBM 생산 라인 다섯 개를 지어요. 건설비가 6조 원, 첨단 장비가 40조 원이고 장비는 단계적으로 들여와요.

sents.en: Samsung plans to invest a total of 46 trillion won, or about $34.5 billion, in the campus.
sents.ko: 삼성은 이 사업장에 모두 46조 원, 약 345억 달러를 투자할 계획이에요.

sents.en: The money will pay for five HBM production lines.
sents.ko: 이 돈으로 HBM 생산 라인 다섯 개를 지어요.

sents.en: About 6 trillion won will go to construction, and 40 trillion won will go to advanced equipment.
sents.ko: 약 6조 원은 건설에, 40조 원은 첨단 장비에 쓰여요.

sents.en: The equipment will be installed in phases.
sents.ko: 장비는 단계적으로 설치돼요.

paragraphs.en: The new building will be the fifth production line at the site. It has three floors and a cleanroom of 31,000 square meters. Samsung plans to start operating the plant in June 2028. The total floor space of the campus will grow from 270,000 to 420,000 square meters. The company expects the facility to create about 700 direct jobs.
paragraphs.ko: 새 건물은 이 사업장의 다섯 번째 생산 라인이에요. 3층이고 클린룸이 3만 1천 제곱미터예요. 2028년 6월 가동이 목표이고 직접 일자리 약 700개가 생길 것으로 기대해요.

sents.en: The new building will be the fifth production line at the site.
sents.ko: 새 건물은 이곳의 다섯 번째 생산 라인이 돼요.

sents.en: It has three floors and a cleanroom of 31,000 square meters.
sents.ko: 3층 건물이고 클린룸 면적은 3만 1천 제곱미터예요.

sents.en: Samsung plans to start operating the plant in June 2028.
sents.ko: 삼성은 2028년 6월에 공장을 가동할 계획이에요.

sents.en: The total floor space of the campus will grow from 270,000 to 420,000 square meters.
sents.ko: 사업장 전체 연면적은 27만에서 42만 제곱미터로 늘어요.

sents.en: The company expects the facility to create about 700 direct jobs.

paragraphs.en: The project is part of a government plan to make the central Chungcheong region a global hub for AI innovation. Lee said the site once focused mainly on basic assembly and testing of conventional chips. The company said the new line will focus on advanced HBM production. The next date to watch is June 2028, when the plant is planned to start running.
paragraphs.ko: 이 사업은 충청 지역을 AI 혁신의 세계적 거점으로 키우려는 정부 계획의 일부예요. 이 회장은 이곳이 예전에는 일반 반도체의 기본 조립과 검사 중심이었다고 말했어요.

sents.en: The project is part of a government plan to make the central Chungcheong region a global hub for AI innovation.
sents.ko: 이 사업은 충청 중부 지역을 AI 혁신의 세계적 거점으로 만들려는 정부 계획의 일부예요.

sents.en: Lee said the site once focused mainly on basic assembly and testing of conventional chips.
sents.ko: 이 회장은 이곳이 예전에는 일반 칩의 기본 조립과 검사에 주로 집중했다고 말했어요.

sents.en: The company said the new line will focus on advanced HBM production.
sents.ko: 회사는 새 라인이 첨단 HBM 생산에 집중할 것이라고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: The next date to watch is June 2028, when the plant is planned to start running.
sents.ko: 다음에 볼 날짜는 공장 가동 예정인 2028년 6월이에요.

pro.en: Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong pledged on Nov. 12 to turn the company's semiconductor operations in Onyang, South Chungcheong Province, into a major hub for advanced chip packaging. Speaking at a groundbreaking ceremony, he singled out high-bandwidth memory, known as HBM, as the core component of AI semiconductors.

The conglomerate intends to commit a total of 46 trillion won, roughly $34.5 billion, to the campus to build five HBM production lines. The outlay comprises 6 trillion won in construction costs and 40 trillion won for advanced equipment, which will be deployed in phases.

The new building, the fifth production line on the site, will be a three-story facility with a 31,000-square-meter cleanroom devoted to advanced HBM production. Operations are scheduled to begin in June 2028, and the campus's total floor space will expand from 270,000 to 420,000 square meters. Samsung expects the facility to generate about 700 direct jobs.

The project forms part of a government initiative to develop the central Chungcheong region into a global hub for AI-driven innovation. Lee noted that the site had long concentrated on basic assembly and testing of conventional semiconductors. The company said the new line will focus on advanced HBM production, with the plant slated to begin operating in June 2028.

pro.en: Stray Kids, the eight-member K-pop act, announced on social media Monday that it had added 25 dates to its ongoing Run It world tour, with new stops across North America and Europe.

The newly announced itinerary includes two nights in Yokohama, Japan, on April 24-25, followed by stops in Seattle on May 16, Chicago on May 18 and Toronto on May 25, then Paris on July 9, London on July 13 and Milan on July 31. The additions lift the tour to 46 performances across 31 regions worldwide.

The tour opened with five sold-out concerts at KSPO Dome in southern Seoul in July and August. The group's latest album, This & That, debuted atop the Billboard 200 in August, giving the act its ninth No. 1 on the U.S. chart, and it has remained on the ranking for 12 consecutive weeks.

Stray Kids has also built an overseas profile through festival appearances, among them Governors Ball in New York and Rock in Rio in Brazil, as well as its own Stray City festival series in Latin America. According to its agency, JYP Entertainment, the newly launched festival drew 270,000 fans over five shows in three cities.

For Korean students, the schedule offers a case study in how a K-pop act sustains an audience abroad, a topic relevant to careers in music and media. Attention now turns to how the newly added shows sell.

views.view: Yonhap reports that the group's album topped the Billboard 200 and its Stray City festival drew 270,000 fans.

issues.title: Court Backs Korea Zinc in Fight Over Shares Sold to Hyundai Motor Group Unit
issues.gist: A Seoul appeals court said Korea Zinc's new shares for a Hyundai Motor Group unit were legal. This reverses a lower court and keeps a friendly 5% stake in place.

paragraphs.en: A Seoul court ruled for Korea Zinc on Nov. 13. Korea Zinc is a South Korean metals company. It had sold new shares worth about 527.2 billion won to a unit of Hyundai Motor Group. pro.en: The Seoul High Court on Nov. 13 sided with Korea Zinc, the South Korean metals producer, ruling that its issuance of new shares worth roughly 527.2 billion won to a Hyundai Motor Group affiliate was lawful and reversing a lower-court judgment that had voided the transaction.

HMG Global, the affiliate, took 1,045,430 new shares in a third-party allotment, a deal that gave Hyundai Motor Group a stake of about 5% and a seat on the board. Young Poong, then the largest shareholder, sued in March 2024, arguing the offering was a means for management to preserve control; the appellate court found the issuance served legitimate business purposes and was grounded in the company's articles of incorporation, whereas the first-instance court had found a charter violation.

Korea Zinc said the rulings showed the courts had clearly recognized its reasonable business judgment, and urged Young Poong and MBK Partners to stop treating strategic cooperation as a weapon in their dispute. Seoul Economic Daily reported that Young Poong is expected to take the case to the Supreme Court, while Maeil Business Newspaper said the company was weighing such an appeal.

Young Poong and MBK together hold about 41% of Korea Zinc, against about 38% for Chairman Choi Yoon-birm's side including friendly stakes, so voiding the issuance would have stripped Hyundai's stake of effect and shifted the balance of voting power. A day earlier, the Seoul Central District Court ruled that resolutions passed at the company's March shareholders meeting last year should be annulled, a decision Korea Zinc said it would appeal immediately; attention now turns to a possible Supreme Court filing.

pro.en: The Seoul Metropolitan Government said Friday that it had lodged criminal complaints against five habitual callers who, between September 2025 and August 2026, inundated the city's 119 emergency dispatch center with 8,710 non-emergency calls and text messages.

The barrage intensified over the summer, with the five accounting for 4,034 contacts from June through August alone, an average of more than 40 a day. One individual placed 2,661 calls, while another sent 2,886 texts, and dispatchers reported silent calls, incoherent rambling and intoxicated callers requesting rides home.

Before pursuing legal action, the center screened the 10 most frequent non-emergency callers of the previous three months, exempting vulnerable elderly residents with minor grievances and cases suspected of stemming from smartphone malfunctions. The remaining callers received repeated warning texts, yet five of them carried on.

Although Korea has long fined those who file malicious false alarms, authorities are increasingly turning to obstruction charges to curb chronic nuisance callers who occupy the lines without reporting a fabricated emergency. Hong Young-geun, head of the Seoul Metropolitan Fire and Disaster Headquarters, said the center's normal operations must never be disrupted by repetitive calls.

The case underscores that a shared emergency line is a finite public resource, as a drunken prank placed late at night could delay help for someone facing genuine danger. Attention now turns to how the complaints against the five are processed.

views.view: It describes the five callers as a serious burden on a lifeline and says Korea is moving from fines to obstruction charges.

pro.en: South Korean equities closed nearly 1 percent lower Friday, with the benchmark KOSPI shedding 52.20 points, or 0.98 percent, to finish at 5,290.53 after opening 2.05 percent higher and touching an intraday peak of 5,504.44 before sliding into negative territory around 12:35 p.m.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has departed his post, with Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress serving as interim chief executive. Major Wall Street indexes ended lower overnight, and investors also awaited US producer price data that could offer clues to Federal Reserve policy.

Lee Kyoung-min of Daishin Securities attributed the reversal to foreign selling and mounting uncertainty over artificial intelligence. Foreign investors unloaded a net 550.5 billion won in shares, while individuals bought a net 17.2 billion won, and turnover remained thin at 237.3 million shares.

Semiconductor shares bore the brunt, with SK hynix down 3.03 percent and Samsung Electronics off 0.96 percent. Naver, in which Nvidia is the third-largest shareholder, tumbled 5.12 percent, while KB Financial Group climbed 4.74 percent and Hyundai Motor added 1.13 percent.
Market participants are expected to keep a close eye on developments in Nvidia's leadership. For Korean students, the episode underscores how a single AI company can move the domestic market.

views.view: Investors grew cautious about how Huang's exit could affect the AI ecosystem, and foreign selling plus AI uncertainty pulled the market down.

pro.en: A Seoul court on Friday ruled against the K-pop agency Belift Lab, a sub-label of the entertainment giant Hybe, in a suit seeking 2 billion won (about $1.5 million) in damages from Min Hee-jin, the former chief executive of ADOR, the label behind NewJeans.

Belift Lab had alleged that Min defamed it by asserting at an April 2024 press conference that its girl group Illit had plagiarized NewJeans, but the Seoul Western District Court rejected the claim that she had disseminated false information, characterizing her remarks as an expression of subjective opinion.

The court also threw out a counter suit in which Min had demanded 5 billion won from Belift Lab, and local headlines attributed the outcome to protections for free expression, with one outlet reporting that an immediate appeal would follow.

The ruling does not close the dispute, since police referred Min to prosecutors last month on suspicion of defamation and obstruction of business, leaving the question of an appeal and a prosecutorial decision still to be resolved.

views.view: The court said Min's words were subjective opinion, and it also threw out her counter suit.
The paper reports that Min called the NewJeans copy claim at an April 2024 press conference, and police sent her to prosecutors on a separate case last month.

The plant sells machines such as the R20 and HERA Z20 to more than 110 territories.

pro.en: Samsung Medison inaugurated a new manufacturing building at its Hongcheon complex in Gangwon Province on Nov. 13, part of a 50 billion won investment, roughly $37.4 million, aimed at lifting the company into the ranks of the world's top three ultrasound makers.

The two-story, 14,548-square-meter facility consolidates production that had been scattered across several buildings, from circuit board assembly through packaging. Output of about 24,000 units this year is slated to rise to as many as 40,000 by 2030, with each scanner containing 15,000 to 20,000 components and boards subjected to 48 hours of power-cycling tests.

The company said revenue rose 16.2% last year, against growth of 3.7% for the global ultrasound equipment market. Chief Executive Yoo Kyu-tae described the expansion as a strategic investment to meet growing global demand, saying Samsung Medison is within reach of a top-three position, with the plant exporting systems such as the R20 and HERA Z20 to more than 110 territories.

The expansion underscores a Korean manufacturer's push to build out medical device production at home, a field that relies on engineers skilled in electronics and quality control. Investors will watch whether demand grows enough to fill the added capacity, while the company is also expanding AI-powered diagnostic software for clinicians.

views.view: The Korea Herald describes the plant as a big step toward top-three status, with output rising from about 24,000 to as many as 40,000 machines by 2030.

pro.en: DeepX Co., a South Korean artificial intelligence chip startup, plans to spend more than $100 million developing its next-generation DX-M2 processor on Samsung Electronics Co.'s advanced 2-nanometer manufacturing process, with the outlay covering development, performance verification and production engineering.

DeepX has completed the DX-M2 design and delivered its final plans to Samsung's foundry unit, and the company anticipates first silicon by March 2027, to be followed by customer evaluations and mass manufacturing in 2028.

The DX-M2 is aimed at robots, industrial equipment and AI personal computers, and it draws roughly 5 watts while running generative AI models, as DeepX wagers that AI workloads will increasingly migrate from remote data centers to local devices, a shift that could reduce energy consumption, costs and latency.

Data centers have drawn mounting public criticism over their power and water consumption, which the report cites as one reason the on-device approach is gaining traction, and the project shows how a small domestic startup can partner with a major chipmaker, with first silicon due by next March and customer testing set for 2028.

pro.en: For the fifth straight review, Seoul has chosen to leave its ceilings on domestic fuel prices untouched, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources announced on Friday, Nov. 13.

The maximum rates at which refiners may sell to gas stations will hold at 1,784 won per liter for gasoline, 1,773 won for diesel and 1,380 won for kerosene throughout the four weeks starting Saturday.

Authorities first imposed the ceilings in mid-March, when the war between the United States and Iran upset supply chains and unsettled fuel markets. Brent crude reached $96 a barrel on Nov. 12, the ministry said, slipping beneath the $100 mark yet remaining more than $20 above where it stood at the end of June.
By holding the line, the ministry hopes to temper inflationary pressure on consumer prices, which are being lifted by expensive crude and elevated ocean freight costs.
Officials added that they would revise the emergency measures if warranted, while keeping a close watch on Middle Eastern developments and on conditions in the domestic economy.

views.view: The government kept the caps for a fifth period because oil prices are still high and Middle East tensions continue.

pro.en: South Korea on Friday convened the inaugural meeting of a new task force charged with easing the cost of living for salaried workers, chaired by First Vice Finance Minister Kwon Dae-young and attended by officials from the relevant ministries. The presidential office had announced the initiative earlier this week.

The task force comprises four working groups covering existing support measures, taxation, fiscal policy and finance. Its stated aim is to lower living costs and boost real disposable income, with particular attention to labor market shifts driven by industrial restructuring and the growing burden of caring for children and elderly parents.

The panel follows a broader task force on disparities, which Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il unveiled on Nov. 11, with five working groups on the labor market, industries, regions, generations and social classes. The government cautioned that AI-driven change could deepen and accelerate gaps, producing a K-shaped divide, and Kwon noted that nonregular workers earned just 61 percent of the wages of regular employees at large companies last year.

Kwon said measures in the 2026 tax revision bill and next year's budget proposal bear directly on wage earners' household finances. He said the government would coordinate closely with ruling and opposition parties while respecting National Assembly deliberations, and would implement the measures swiftly once they pass.

The larger task force's working groups will meet weekly and its steering group at least twice a month, with each working group due to report its detailed goals by early December. Policy measures agreed among ministries by the end of the year will be folded into the 2027 economic growth strategy.

pro.en: The South Korean won strengthened to its highest level in 15 days against the US dollar on Nov. 12, closing the afternoon session at 1,330.7 won per dollar. It touched 1,327.7 at one point, its strongest since Oct. 28, as foreign investors remained net buyers of local equities and exporters sold dollars.

Data released Friday by the Bank of Korea showed import prices fell 1.8 percent in October from the previous month, reversing a 1.9 percent gain in September. The central bank attributed the decline to a 1.6 percent appreciation of the won against the dollar over the month and a 2.6 percent drop in Dubai crude, South Korea's benchmark.

Raw material prices slid 3 percent and intermediate goods slipped 1 percent, while the export price index climbed 0.7 percent after a 0.5 percent decline in September. The Bank of Korea described import prices as a key driver of inflation because they feed through to production costs and consumer prices across the supply chain.

The won reversed course on Nov. 13, finishing at 1,336.7 per dollar, down 6 won on the day, as global oil prices surged. Brent crude futures jumped 3.3 percent to $95.82 a barrel after Donald Trump said there was no need for a deal with Iran, and Iranian media reported that tankers had been hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz. Foreign investors sold a net 550 billion won of local shares, and the benchmark KOSPI fell 0.98 percent to 5,290.53.
For students planning study abroad or overseas purchases, the exchange rate translates directly into costs. How the won and crude prices shape import prices will be the next thing to watch.

issues.title: South Korea Promises Zero Tolerance for AI Glasses Cheating on the College Entrance Exam
issues.gist: The South Korean government says it will not accept cheating with AI glasses on next week's college entrance exam. The worry grew after a near-perfect score in a tax accountant exam.
issues.gistKo: 정부가 다음 주 수능에서 AI 안경을 쓴 부정행위를 절대 용납하지 않겠다고 밝혔어요. 세무사 시험에서 만점에 가까운 점수가 나와 의심이 커진 뒤였어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 눈에 안 띄는 AI 안경으로 시험 답을 찾는 일을 막겠다는 뜻이에요. 수능 감독을 더 세게 하고, 걸리면 형사 고발까지 한다고 해요.

paragraphs.en: The South Korean government said on Friday that it will not accept cheating with AI glasses on the college entrance exam. The exam is called the College Scholastic Ability Test, and it is set for next Thursday. Officials called the cheating a serious problem for students who have worked hard.
paragraphs.ko: 정부는 금요일, 다음 주 목요일 치러지는 수능에서 AI 안경을 이용한 부정행위를 용납하지 않겠다고 밝혔어요. 성실히 준비한 학생들의 공정한 기회를 해치는 심각한 문제라고 봤어요.

sents.en: The South Korean government said on Friday that it will not accept cheating with AI glasses on the college entrance exam.

sents.en: The government promised to watch the exam closely until it ends.
sents.ko: 정부는 시험이 끝날 때까지 면밀히 지켜보겠다고 약속했어요.

pro.en: The government pledged Friday to take a zero-tolerance approach to cheating with AI glasses on the College Scholastic Ability Test, due next Thursday, saying such conduct undermines fair opportunities for students who have prepared diligently.

Suspicions surfaced after the top scorer in this year's certified tax accountant exam missed just one of 160 questions on the first-round test, earning 397.5 points out of 400, a result many test-takers view as unrealistic; the government said it would request an investigation.

Specialized personnel will be deployed to exam sites to detect AI glasses, and offenders will face stern action, including criminal complaints, with KBS reporting that those caught may also forfeit eligibility to retake the exam for three years, while officials plan a broader review of state-run exam management.

The government vowed to monitor the administration of the exam closely until it concludes, and attention now turns to the outcome of the tax exam inquiry and to new measures aimed at smart-device cheating.

issues.title: LG Founding Family Member Is Brought Back From Cambodia After Eight Years on the Run
issues.gist: A member of the family that founded LG Group was sent back to South Korea from Cambodia. Police say he left in 2018 to avoid a stock manipulation investigation.

paragraphs.en: Koo Bon-hyun, a member of the family that founded LG Group, was sent back to South Korea from Cambodia. He left the country eight years ago to escape an investigation. Police held him when he arrived on Monday. He was formally arrested on Wednesday under a court warrant.

paragraphs.en: Koo is 57 years old and a nephew of the late LG honorary chairman Koo Cha-kyung. pro.en: Koo Bon-hyun, a member of the family that founded conglomerate LG Group, was repatriated from Cambodia eight years after leaving South Korea to escape an investigation. He was detained upon arrival on Monday and formally arrested on Wednesday under a court-issued warrant.

The 57-year-old, a nephew of the late LG Group honorary chairman Koo Cha-kyung, is being investigated by the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency on suspicion of violating the Capital Markets Act, embezzlement and breach of trust. He left for the Netherlands in 2018, and police, who obtained a detention warrant in 2019, requested an Interpol Red Notice before Cambodian police apprehended him in September.

Investigators suspect that he reaped illegal profits of 14.5 billion won, or $10.9 million, by disclosing false information about a KOSDAQ-listed company that he had acquired without capital. He is also accused of embezzling 4.6 billion won from the firm, including for entertainment expenses, although the allegations have yet to be tested in court.

Koo had previously received a finalized three-year prison sentence in 2012 in a separate stock manipulation case. The latest case underscores how seriously authorities treat market manipulation, with the investigation and any trial still ahead.

issues.title: South Korea's rice production falls for the fifth year in a row in 2026
issues.gist: South Korea's rice output fell 0.9 percent to 3.5 million tons in 2026, the fifth yearly drop. Rice paddies also shrank to the smallest area on record as eating habits change.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's rice production fell for the fifth year in a row in 2026. Data released on Friday by the Ministry of Data and Statistics show that output fell 0.9 percent from a year earlier to 3.5 million tons. This is the fourth-lowest level since the government began collecting the data in 1965.

pro.en: South Korea's rice output declined for a fifth consecutive year in 2026, according to figures released Friday by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. Production slipped 0.9 percent from the previous year to 3.5 million tons. It was the fourth-lowest total since the government began compiling the data in 1965.

The cultivated area also contracted, with rice paddies totaling 670,000 hectares, down 1.1 percent from a year earlier and the smallest on record. Even so, the yield per 1,000 square meters edged up 0.2 percent to 524 kilograms.

The reports attributed the decline to shifting dietary preferences. Rice remains a staple of the Korean diet, but consumption has fallen steadily over recent decades. The government has also sought to manage production by encouraging farmers to switch to other crops. South Jeolla Province and Gwangju combined produced the most, at 736,000 tons, followed by South Chungcheong Province at 681,000 tons and North Jeolla Province at 526,000 tons.

For younger Koreans who eat less rice than older relatives, the figures reflect a broader change in the national diet. The next data release will show whether output falls for a sixth straight year and whether the area under paddies continues to shrink.

views.view: Rice output fell for a fifth year as eating habits changed, and the paddy area hit a record low.
Rice is still a staple, but people eat less of it, and the government is encouraging farmers to grow other crops.
