pro.en: The remains of two Korean independence fighters, interred in the United States and Uzbekistan, will be repatriated next week, the veterans ministry announced Friday. They are Ho Si-han, buried in the U.S., and Lee Gwal, buried in Uzbekistan, and the return will be the first of an independence activist laid to rest in Uzbekistan.

The remains are due to arrive in Korea on Sunday, and a ceremony attended by some 300 people is scheduled for Monday at a memorial park in Seoul. Both men will subsequently be reinterred at the national cemetery in the central city of Daejeon.

Ho, born in Seoul in 1885, was detained by Japanese police while raising military funds after the March 1 independence movement, and he died in Los Angeles in 1956. Lee, born in North Hamgyong Province in 1898, served as a diplomatic delegate of the Korean Provisional Government in the early 1920s before being deported to Uzbekistan in 1937, where he died.

The repatriation coincides with the 80th anniversary of civilian and government-led efforts that began in 1946 with the return of three renowned fighters, among them Yun Bong-gil. To date, 158 sets of remains have been brought home from 14 countries, while the ministry has identified 240 tombs across 10 countries and intends to repatriate more after consulting bereaved families.

The two men took part in the struggle against Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule of Korea, and their return keeps that history in the public eye. Attention now turns to Monday's ceremony and the burial in Daejeon.

views.view: The ministry says this is the first return from Uzbekistan and gives short life stories of Ho and Lee.
The return marks 80 years of efforts to bring home remains of activists, and 240 tombs in 10 countries are known.

pro.en: The Seoul Central District Court on Thursday sentenced three members of a criminal ring to prison terms for collaborating with North Korean hackers to build and distribute illegal gambling websites in South Korea. One defendant received four years and the other two three years apiece.

The trio had been tried as accomplices to the ringleader, surnamed Kim, who was convicted of the same offenses in September and sentenced to five years. Kim was found to have created 16 illegal gambling sites with North Korean hackers between 2022 and 2024 and sold them to domestic operators, earning about 23.5 billion won, of which more than 7 billion won, roughly 30 percent, went to the hackers. His sentence also included a five-year suspension of qualifications.

The court found the first defendant guilty of violating the National Security Act and operating illegal gambling sites, and it added a four-year suspension of qualifications, while one of the other two also received a three-year suspension.

views.view: Three ring members were sentenced as accomplices to a ringleader who sent about 30 percent of his earnings to North Korean hackers.

issues.title: Seoul Says Google Met Key Security Steps to Export Korean Map Data, Picks Tmap as Partner
issues.gist: South Korea said Google has put in place key security steps for exporting detailed Korean map data. Google chose Tmap Mobility to process the base map data.
issues.gistKo: 한국 정부가 구글이 상세한 한국 지도 데이터를 반출하는 데 필요한 핵심 보안 조치를 갖췄다고 확인했어요. 구글은 기본 지도 데이터를 처리할 현지 파트너로 티맵모빌리티를 골랐어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea said on Friday that Google has put in place key security steps for exporting detailed Korean map data. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a review committee checked Google's work after a meeting with officials and experts. On Feb. 27, Seoul gave Google conditional approval to send 1:5,000-scale map data abroad. That approval ended a 19-year standoff over the request. Google sent its final report on the security steps on Nov. 4.

paragraphs.en: Google removed latitude and longitude coordinates for South Korean territory from Google Maps and Google Earth. It also built a Korea-specific control system that blocks app updates if restricted location information is found. Sensitive sites such as military bases are blurred in satellite images, but the switch to images screened by Korean authorities is not finished. Google also removed Street View images of those sites and of roads within 50 meters of their edges. Under an Aug. 31 agreement, Google will get satellite images processed by the National Geographic Information Institute through a domestic partner.

pro.en: South Korea confirmed on Friday that Google had implemented key security measures required to export detailed Korean map data, as an interagency committee of officials and private-sector experts reviewed the company's compliance, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said. The verification follows Seoul's conditional approval on Feb. 27 to export 1:5,000-scale map data, which ended a 19-year standoff. Google submitted its final report on the safeguards on Nov. 4.

Google has stripped latitude and longitude coordinates for South Korean territory from Google Maps and Google Earth, and developed a Korea-specific control system that blocks app updates if restricted location data is detected. It has temporarily blurred military installations and other sensitive facilities, although the transition to imagery screened by Korean authorities remains incomplete. Street View images of those sites and of roads within 50 meters of their boundaries have been removed. Under an Aug. 31 agreement, Google will obtain satellite imagery processed by the National Geographic Information Institute through a domestic partner.

Industry sources said Google had selected Tmap Mobility as its local partner to process base map data, with Google expected to begin using Tmap-processed data on servers in South Korea as early as 2027. Only base maps and transport-related information, including road names, lane counts and speed limits, are eligible for export, and the arrangement excludes Tmap users' personal information, real-time locations, search histories and driving routes. The two companies have kept a partnership since 2008; neither has disclosed the contract's duration or value, which industry estimates put at several million dollars annually.

Google has designated the president of Google Korea as its local contact on map matters and set up a 24-hour system to handle government requests, and must complete corrective action within one business day of any security violation being identified. Officials said serious breaches could result in the suspension or revocation of its export approval, and that they would continue to monitor whether coordinate restrictions remain in place. KED Global reported that Google is poised to expand its mapping services in a market dominated by Naver, Kakao and SK Telecom.

KED Global said an upgrade could come as early as the beginning of next year, a change likely to be noticed first by foreign visitors and exchange students who already rely on Google Maps. Attention now turns to when the Korean-processed imagery arrives and whether Google keeps the coordinate restrictions in place.

views.view: Seoul says Google met key security steps, but it will keep checking and may cancel approval for serious violations.
Google is poised to expand its mapping services in Korea, a market led by Naver, Kakao and SK Telecom.

pro.en: Samsung and Google have opened preorders for their first Android XR smart glasses, a collection of 30 frame variations from the eyewear brands Gentle Monster and Warby Parker that Samsung markets as Intelligent Eyewear. The glasses are due to go on sale on Dec. 10.

The line is built around nine core frame styles in multiple colors: six from Gentle Monster and three from Warby Parker, namely Alden, Reid and Wren. Prescription lenses are supported, each pair weighs about 41 grams, and the glasses are rated for nine hours on a single charge, with a carrying case that can recharge them seven times.

Warby Parker models start from $395 and Gentle Monster frames from $449, with premium options reaching $489. Android Central described the pricing as undercutting Meta’s, while Android Authority said the glasses are lighter than Meta Ray-Ban models, and they are compatible with newer Galaxy handsets running One UI 9, Pixel 7 and later, and iPhone 13 Pro and later.

Beyond capturing photos, Android Central said the glasses can identify landmarks, translate restaurant menus, provide directions via Google Maps and summarize a meeting whiteboard. Availability will initially be limited to the US and South Korea, Samsung’s home market.

Attention now turns to the Dec. 10 launch. Android Authority cautioned that real-world battery life will vary with how heavily owners use the cameras and the AI assistant, so post-launch reviews should show whether the stated figures hold up.

pro.en: Hyundai Card is extending its proprietary AI platform to partner companies in Korea as part of its PLCC 2.0 strategy, which reworks the private-label credit card business it runs jointly with partner brands. A PLCC is a card issued under a partner's brand.

Universe for Partners, or U4P, a partner version of its in-house platform Universe, lets partners run their own AI-driven customer analysis, recommendations and predictions, whereas Hyundai Card previously analyzed their customer data and handled marketing on their behalf.

The company now favors partners keen on data collaboration, citing about 260 million combined customer touchpoints and more than 5,000 data marketing initiatives to date, and it intends to renew its entire PLCC lineup by the first half of 2027.
Ryu Su-jin, who heads the PLCC division, said that frequency of use matters more than the number of cards issued. Genesis is likewise moving to adopt U4P.

views.view: Hyundai Card says partners can use AI themselves and that how often cards are used matters more than how many are issued.

issues.title: Korean Regulator Approves Hyundai Home Shopping Split with Five Conditions
issues.gist: Korea's broadcast regulator has approved a plan to split Hyundai Home Shopping into two companies. It set five conditions to keep the TV shopping business stable.
issues.gistKo: 방송미디어통신위원회가 현대홈쇼핑을 두 회사로 나누는 계획을 조건부로 승인했어요. 홈쇼핑 사업이 흔들리지 않도록 조건 다섯 가지를 붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: On Nov. 13, South Korea's Broadcast Media and Telecommunications Commission approved the split of Hyundai Home Shopping. The company will separate its investment business into a new firm, tentatively called Hyundai Home Shopping Holdings. The old company will stay and keep running the home shopping business. The new firm will take over stakes in the group's other companies.
paragraphs.ko: 방송미디어통신위원회가 11월 13일 전체회의에서 현대홈쇼핑의 법인분할을 조건부로 승인했어요. 투자 사업을 떼어 가칭 현대홈쇼핑지주를 새로 만들고, 기존 회사는 홈쇼핑을 계속해요.

sents.en: The company will separate its investment business into a new firm, tentatively called Hyundai Home Shopping Holdings.
sents.ko: 회사는 투자 사업을 가칭 현대홈쇼핑지주라는 새 회사로 떼어내요.

sents.en: The old company will stay and keep running the home shopping business.
sents.ko: 기존 회사는 남아서 계속 홈쇼핑 사업을 운영해요.

sents.en: The new firm will take over stakes in the group's other companies.
sents.ko: 새 회사는 그룹 다른 계열사의 지분을 이어받아요.

paragraphs.en: A panel of experts checked seven review items from Nov. 4 to 6. Hyundai Home Shopping was found suitable on all of them. Still, the panel raised worries about less open management after the company becomes unlisted. It also pointed to possible money outflows and the need to manage the new firm's assets well.
paragraphs.ko: 전문가 심사위원회가 7개 항목을 살폈고 모두 적격 판정을 냈어요. 다만 비상장 전환 뒤 경영 투명성이 낮아질 수 있고 자금이 빠져나갈 수 있으며, 새 투자회사의 자산 관리를 보완해야 한다는 우려가 나왔어요.

sents.en: A panel of experts checked seven review items from Nov. 4 to 6.

sents.en: Hyundai Home Shopping was found suitable on all of them.
sents.ko: 현대홈쇼핑은 모든 항목에서 적격 판정을 받았어요.

sents.en: Still, the panel raised worries about less open management after the company becomes unlisted.

sents.en: It also pointed to possible money outflows and the need to manage the new firm's assets well.

paragraphs.en: The commission set five conditions. First, the share of outside directors on the board must stay at or above the level in the application. Second, the company must report dividends and deals with related parties. Third, both companies must share responsibility for debts from before the split. Fourth, the new firm must put 50 billion won into responsible management and send a written pledge. Fifth, the fund for partner companies must be run at the same level as before, and the number of supported firms must not fall.

sents.en: First, the share of outside directors on the board must stay at or above the level in the application.

paragraphs.en: Chairman Kim Jong-cheol said the review focused on keeping the broadcast business stable. He said the company must carry out the conditions fully. Next, people will watch whether the support for partner companies continues.
paragraphs.ko: 위원장 김종철은 방송 사업에 차질이 없도록 필요한 조건을 붙였다고 했고, 회사가 조건을 성실히 지켜야 한다고 했어요. 홈쇼핑 협력사와 시청자에게 지원 약속이 이어지는지가 앞으로 볼 점이에요.

sents.en: Chairman Kim Jong-cheol said the review focused on keeping the broadcast business stable.
sents.ko: 김종철 위원장은 심사가 방송 사업의 안정에 초점을 맞췄다고 했어요.

sents.en: He said the company must carry out the conditions fully.
sents.ko: 그는 회사가 조건을 충분히 이행해야 한다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Next, people will watch whether the support for partner companies continues.
sents.ko: 다음으로 협력사 지원이 이어지는지 지켜볼 거예요.

pro.en: South Korea's Broadcast Media and Telecommunications Commission on Nov. 13 conditionally approved the corporate split of Hyundai Home Shopping, under which its investment arm will be carved out into a new entity tentatively named Hyundai Home Shopping Holdings, while the existing company remains the surviving entity running the home shopping business and the new firm inherits stakes in affiliates.

An expert review panel assessed seven items from Nov. 4 to 6 and rated the company suitable on every count, yet the review flagged reduced management transparency once the company goes unlisted, the potential for capital outflows and the need to supplement oversight of assets allocated to the new investment company.

The five conditions require the company to keep the proportion of outside directors at or above the level in its application, submit details on dividends and related-party transactions, maintain joint liability between the surviving and new companies for pre-split debts, submit a letter of commitment guaranteeing a 50 billion won injection for responsible management, and sustain the execution rate of its partner mutual growth fund and the number of supported partner firms at application levels.

Commission Chairman Kim Jong-cheol said the review centered on the stability and continuity of the broadcasting business, adding that the company must faithfully carry out the conditions and meet its obligations to viewers and suppliers.

views.view: The regulator approved the split but listed five conditions because of lower transparency, possible money outflows and asset management.

pro.en: President Lee Jae Myung of South Korea has arranged one-on-one meetings next Monday afternoon with Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Philippine President Ferdinand Romualdez Marcos Jr. Lee will meet each of the two leaders separately.

Both sessions are to take place on the margins of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit, which Lee will attend in Manila on Monday and Tuesday; presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung laid out the itinerary on Friday.

Lee will afterward proceed to Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday for a two-day appearance at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, where he is also due to host a luncheon for South Korean residents of southern China, a community of roughly 24,000 nationals.

Southeast Asia lies close to Korea, so many students may follow these ties, although the reports did not say what the leaders will discuss, and attention will turn to the outcomes after the meetings. The reports did not describe the agenda of either meeting.

sents.en: He said South Korea spearheaded a UN General Assembly resolution on military AI.

sents.ko: 모든 단계에서 국제법을 지켜야 하고, 사람이 통제와 책임을 맡아야 한다고 말했어요.

pro.en: Senior South Korean and United Nations officials held a meeting in Seoul on Friday, Nov. 13, when Vice Foreign Minister for Strategy and Intelligence Jeong Yeon-doo sat down with Izumi Nakamitsu, the UN High Representative for Disarmament Affairs. The talks took place on the sidelines of the two-day Korea-UN Conference on Disarmament and Nonproliferation, which opened in Seoul on Thursday.

Their discussions spanned the security picture on the Korean Peninsula and Pyongyang's nuclear program, as well as the findings of the UN General Assembly's First Committee and avenues for closer collaboration between Seoul and the UN disarmament office.

Jeong underscored the importance of multilateral cooperation in ensuring that AI is employed responsibly in military settings. He noted that South Korea had spearheaded a General Assembly resolution on military AI and had co-hosted a related summit with the Netherlands.

Nakamitsu cautioned that the rapid pace of AI development could open up new vulnerabilities and heighten the danger of miscalculation and unintended escalation. She insisted that international law be upheld throughout, with humans retaining control and responsibility, and singled out policy grounded in technical expertise and appropriate venues for dialogue as priorities, according to the foreign ministry.

pro.en: Binance, a global cryptocurrency exchange, announced Thursday that every asset hit by the cyberattack had now been made whole, at a cost of upward of $6.34 billion in corporate money. The intrusion occurred on Oct. 29.

According to the company, the money came from its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), a futures insurance fund and the firm's own treasury, and the affected tokens were bought back through open-market and over-the-counter deals. Binance also vowed to rebuild SAFU to about $1 billion so that it can again serve as an emergency cushion for users.

Hackers allegedly connected to North Korea made off with more than $6 billion in digital assets. The US Federal Bureau of Investigation pinned the theft on a North Korean group called TraderTraitor and cautioned that the loot might be laundered via decentralized finance platforms and crypto exchange services. Kim Yo-jong, the sister of Kim Jong-un, brushed aside the finding as a “grave political provocation.”

The US State Department restated its worry that North Korea relies on cybercrime to bankroll its weapons programs, calling it a worldwide problem for companies and jurisdictions alike. The next question is whether the stolen assets are laundered, as the FBI cautioned.

issues.title: South Korea Says Nvidia Will Keep Its 260,000 GPU Pledge After CEO Jensen Huang Resigns

pro.en: South Korea's Science and ICT Minister Bae Kyung-hoon said in a social media post on Friday that Nvidia had confirmed it would deliver the 260,000 advanced GPUs it pledged. The commitment holds, he said, notwithstanding the resignation of Chief Executive Jensen Huang.

The 260,000-GPU accord was struck last year at the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation meetings during Huang's visit to South Korea, and Nvidia's board has named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO. The ministry's second vice minister chaired a review meeting with Nvidia on Friday morning, after which Bae said the company intends to proceed with the supply and with cooperation with Korean firms.

The two sides will also continue work on linking Korean-made AI chips to Nvidia's platform, building AI computing infrastructure, and conducting joint research and talent training in physical AI. Efforts to bring GTC, Nvidia's annual developer conference, to Korea will proceed as well.

Separately, Seoul's plan to secure 50,000 GPUs is on track, Bae said. Of the roughly 35,000 units the government is procuring directly, about 21,000 have been secured, with some 14,000 more due by early 2027, while a further 15,000 or so are being obtained through the National AI Computing Center.
With Kress at the helm on an interim basis, Nvidia's next steps in Korea bear watching.

issues.title: Samsung Electronics Moves Toward a Seventh Labor Union
issues.gist: A seventh labor union is being set up at Samsung Electronics. It comes nine days after a sixth union filed its papers, before next year's pay talks.
issues.gistKo: 삼성전자에서 일곱 번째 노동조합이 만들어지고 있어요. 여섯 번째 노조가 설립 신고를 한 지 9일 만이고, 내년 임금 협상을 앞두고 있어요.

paragraphs.en: A seventh labor union is being set up at Samsung Electronics. Its papers were filed on Nov. 13 at a regional labor office in Gwangju. The sixth union filed its papers on Nov. 4. That is the second new union this month.
paragraphs.ko: 삼성전자에서 일곱 번째 노동조합 설립이 추진되고 있어요. 11월 13일 '삼성전자 광주 노조'의 설립 신고서가 광주지방고용노동청에 제출됐어요. 여섯 번째 노조의 신고서는 11월 4일에 제출됐어요.

sents.en: A seventh labor union is being set up at Samsung Electronics.
sents.ko: 삼성전자에서 일곱 번째 노동조합이 만들어지고 있어요.

sents.en: Its papers were filed on Nov. 13 at a regional labor office in Gwangju.
sents.ko: 설립 신고서는 11월 13일 광주의 지방 노동 관청에 제출됐어요.

sents.en: The sixth union filed its papers on Nov. 4.
sents.ko: 여섯 번째 노조는 11월 4일에 신고서를 냈어요.

sents.en: That is the second new union this month.
sents.ko: 이번 달에만 두 번째 새 노조예요.

paragraphs.en: Lee Won-il is expected to lead the new union. He used to head the Gwangju branch of the Samsung Electronics Enterprise Union. He is one of two officials who were expelled when that union reorganized around its chip unit. The new union plans to work mainly at the Gwangju site.
paragraphs.ko: 새 노조의 위원장은 삼성전자 기업노조 광주지부장이었던 이원일 씨가 맡을 것으로 알려졌어요. 그는 DX 부문 출신으로, 기업노조가 반도체를 맡은 DS 부문 중심으로 바뀌는 과정에서 제명된 임원 두 명 가운데 한 명이에요. 새 노조는 광주 사업장을 중심으로 운영될 계획이에요.

sents.en: Lee Won-il is expected to lead the new union.
sents.ko: 이원일 씨가 새 노조를 이끌 것으로 보여요.

sents.en: He used to head the Gwangju branch of the Samsung Electronics Enterprise Union.
sents.ko: 그는 삼성전자 기업노조 광주지부장이었어요.

sents.en: He is one of two officials who were expelled when that union reorganized around its chip unit.
sents.ko: 그는 기업노조가 반도체 부문 중심으로 개편될 때 제명된 두 명 가운데 한 명이에요.

sents.en: The new union plans to work mainly at the Gwangju site.
sents.ko: 새 노조는 주로 광주 사업장에서 활동할 계획이에요.

paragraphs.en: Samsung Electronics now has five unions. The biggest one, the Enterprise Union, has 53,480 members. Before next year's pay talks, the unions must agree on one bargaining window. A union with a majority of members speaks for workers. If no union has a majority, they form a joint team.
paragraphs.ko: 지금 삼성전자에는 노조가 다섯 개 있고, 가장 큰 기업노조의 조합원은 53,480명이에요. 내년 임금·단체협약 협상 전에 교섭 창구를 하나로 모아야 하고, 조합원 과반이 된 노조가 대표 교섭 노조가 돼요. 과반 노조가 없으면 공동 교섭단이 꾸려져요.

sents.en: Samsung Electronics now has five unions.
sents.ko: 삼성전자에는 지금 노조가 다섯 개 있어요.

sents.en: The biggest one, the Enterprise Union, has 53,480 members.
sents.ko: 가장 큰 기업노조에는 조합원이 53,480명 있어요.

sents.en: Before next year's pay talks, the unions must agree on one bargaining window.
sents.ko: 내년 임금 협상 전에 노조들은 교섭 창구를 하나로 정해야 해요.

sents.en: A union with a majority of members speaks for workers.
sents.ko: 조합원 과반을 가진 노조가 노동자를 대표해요.

sents.en: If no union has a majority, they form a joint team.
sents.ko: 과반 노조가 없으면 공동 교섭단을 꾸려요.

paragraphs.en: The Donghaeng Union said it was worried about the new unions. It asked how more unions help staff, and said splits inside the Enterprise Union are now clear. If both new unions finish the steps, Samsung will have seven. Watch which union becomes the lead bargainer next year.
paragraphs.ko: 동행노조는 성명을 내고 노조가 계속 늘어나는 상황이 임직원에게 실제로 어떤 도움이 되는지 물었어요. 기업노조 안의 갈등과 분열이 더 눈에 띈다고 했어요. 두 새 노조의 설립 절차가 끝나면 노조는 모두 일곱 개가 돼요.

sents.en: The Donghaeng Union said it was worried about the new unions.
sents.ko: 동행노조는 새 노조들이 걱정된다고 했어요.

sents.en: It asked how more unions help staff, and said splits inside the Enterprise Union are now clear.
sents.ko: 동행노조는 노조가 늘면 직원에게 어떤 도움이 되느냐고 묻고, 기업노조 안의 분열이 두드러진다고 했어요.

sents.en: If both new unions finish the steps, Samsung will have seven.
sents.ko: 두 새 노조가 절차를 마치면 삼성전자에는 노조가 일곱 개가 돼요.

sents.en: Watch which union becomes the lead bargainer next year.
sents.ko: 내년에 어느 노조가 교섭 대표가 되는지 지켜보세요.

pro.en: Preparations are under way to form a seventh labor union at Samsung Electronics, with registration papers for the Samsung Electronics Gwangju Labor Union lodged on Nov. 13 at the Gwangju Regional Employment and Labor Office, nine days after paperwork for the sixth union was filed on Nov. 4 and marking the second new union this month.

Lee Won-il, who headed the Gwangju branch of the Samsung Electronics Enterprise Union, is expected to chair the new body. Lee, of the Device eXperience unit, is one of two officials expelled as the Enterprise Union restructured around the Device Solutions division that oversees semiconductors, and the new union plans to operate chiefly from the Gwangju site.

Samsung Electronics currently has five unions, the largest of which, the Enterprise Union, counts 53,480 members. Ahead of next year's wage and collective bargaining, the unions must unify their bargaining channels, and a union holding a majority of members becomes the representative bargaining union; absent a majority, a joint bargaining delegation is formed.

The Donghaeng Union, centered on the DX unit, issued a statement voicing concern over the proliferation of unions, questioning how it practically benefits executives and employees and arguing that rifts within the Enterprise Union are being highlighted. Once procedures for both new unions are completed, the number of unions at the company would rise from five to seven.

views.view: The seventh union is being set up as unions prepare for next year's pay talks and the choice of a lead bargainer.
The Donghaeng Union worries that more unions show splits in the Enterprise Union instead of helping workers.

issues.title: Samsung Lions Win the Korean Series, and Two Stars Reach Free Agency
issues.gist: The Samsung Lions beat the KT Wiz in five games to win the Korean Series. Two Lions stars are now among 28 players eligible for free agency.
issues.gistKo: 삼성 라이온즈가 KT 위즈를 5경기 만에 꺾고 한국시리즈 우승을 차지했어요. 라이온즈의 두 스타는 FA 자격을 얻은 28명 안에 들어 있어요.

paragraphs.en: The Samsung Lions won the 2026 Korean Series in Daegu. They beat the KT Wiz in five games. The Lions lost the first game of the series. Then they won the next four games. It is their first title since 2014.
paragraphs.ko: 삼성 라이온즈가 대구에서 KT 위즈를 꺾고 2026 한국시리즈 우승을 차지했어요. 5차전에서 시리즈를 끝냈고, 2014년 이후 첫 우승이에요. 1차전은 졌지만 이후 4경기 중 4경기를 이겼어요.

sents.ko: 박진만 감독은 5차전 전에 특별한 연설을 하지 않았다고 했어요.

sents.en: He only wanted his players to keep having fun.
sents.ko: 그는 선수들이 계속 즐기기만을 바랐어요.

sents.ko: 그는 20타수 10안타에 홈런 1개, 6타점을 기록했어요.

sents.ko: 그는 올해 타율 .371로 첫 타격왕도 차지했어요.

sents.ko: 26세 원태인은 마지막 경기의 승리투수였어요.

sents.en: Koo and Won are the two biggest names on the list.
sents.ko: 구자욱과 원태인이 명단에서 가장 큰 두 이름이에요.

sents.en: Won went 7-9 with a 4.52 ERA in the regular season.
sents.ko: 원태인은 정규시즌에 7승 9패, 평균자책점 4.52를 기록했어요.

paragraphs.ko: 선수들은 일요일까지 FA 권리를 쓸지 정해야 해요. 최종 명단은 월요일에 나오고, 화요일부터 어느 구단과도 협상할 수 있어요. 야구 팬인 대학생은 이 겨울의 이적 소식을 눈여겨볼 만해요.

sents.ko: 선수들은 일요일까지 FA 권리를 쓸지 정해야 해요.

sents.ko: 야구 팬은 두 스타가 어디로 가는지 지켜보세요.

pro.en: Samsung secured the 2026 Korean Series in Daegu, closing out the KT Wiz in five games to claim the franchise's first title since 2014 after dropping the opener.

Manager Park Jin-man said he delivered no special pep talk before Game 5, asking only that his players keep enjoying themselves, and he credited outfielder Park Seung-kyu with transforming the team's culture through exuberant celebrations after key hits and plays.

Captain Koo Ja-wook, 33, was voted series MVP after going 10-for-20 with a homer and six RBIs, having already captured his first batting title at .371, while 26-year-old Won Tae-in earned the win in the clincher by allowing one run over five innings.

The KBO announced on Friday that 28 players qualify for free agency this offseason, with Koo and Won the marquee names; Won's 7-9 record and 4.52 ERA were his worst in years, yet a thin market for starters is expected to attract suitors, and the Lions are expected to try to retain Koo.
Eligible players have until Sunday to exercise their rights, the league will publish the final list on Monday, and negotiations with all clubs may begin on Tuesday.

views.view: The Lions' manager said his team simply kept having fun, and the title run ended a long wait since 2014.
Two stars of the title run, Koo and Won, lead the list of 28 players who can become free agents.

issues.gist: South Korea lost to Australia and then to Japan in its first two games in Tokyo. It must now beat Taiwan and hope for help to reach the final.

pro.en: South Korea fell 7-8 to Australia in its opening game of the Asia Professional Baseball Championship at Tokyo Dome. Australia built a 4-0 lead on a three-run homer by Blake Cavill, but Korea rallied to go ahead 6-4 before surrendering four runs over the final two innings. A sacrifice fly by Kim Do-yeong trimmed the deficit to a run, yet the tying run never crossed the plate.

Korea then lost 9-5 to Japan the following day, undone by four home runs, none more damaging than the go-ahead three-run shot by Rui Muneyama in the bottom of the eighth. Kim Whee-jip had pulled Korea level at 5-5 with a three-run homer in the top half of that inning, but Japan added another run and Korea could not respond.

The event is restricted to players aged 24 or younger, or those with no more than three years of professional experience, though each roster may include up to three players aged between 24 and 29. Korea fielded mostly young stars from the Korea Baseball Organization and had finished runner-up to Japan in both previous editions.

Korea next faces Taiwan at 7 p.m. Saturday. To reach the final, it needs a victory over Taiwan and a Japanese win over Australia, which would leave Korea, Taiwan and Australia all at 1-2 and send the three into a tiebreaking formula to determine Japan's opponent.

views.view: Korea lost its opener to Australia after a comeback effort went for nothing late in the game.
Korea lost to Japan after failing to hold an early lead and giving up four home runs.

issues.title: South Korea Changes Its Plan to Merge Three Military Academies and Asks Cadets for Their Views
issues.gist: South Korea's defense ministry is changing its plan to merge the Army, Navy and Air Force academies after strong pushback. It is also running a survey of cadets.
issues.gistKo: 한국 국방부가 육·해·공군 사관학교를 합치려던 계획을 거센 반발 끝에 고치고 있어요. 생도들에게 설문조사도 하고 있어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 세 사관학교를 하나로 합치겠다던 계획이 동문과 지역 주민의 반발에 부딪혔어요. 그래서 국방부가 계획을 손보면서 생도 2,350명의 의견도 묻고 있어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's defense ministry wants to merge its Army, Air Force and Navy academies into one school. This week the ministry said it is changing that plan. A new version would build a joint academy in Daejeon. The Navy and Air Force academies would stay in Jinhae and Cheongju. The Army academy would move to the Chungcheong region.
paragraphs.ko: 국방부는 육·해·공군 사관학교를 하나로 합치려 했어요. 이번 주 계획을 고쳤다고 밝혔어요. 새 안은 대전에 통합 사관학교를 세우는 것이에요. 해군과 공군 사관학교는 진해와 청주에 남고, 육군 사관학교는 충청 지역으로 옮겨요.

sents.en: South Korea's defense ministry wants to merge its Army, Air Force and Navy academies into one school.
sents.ko: 한국 국방부는 육군, 공군, 해군 사관학교를 하나의 학교로 합치려고 해요.

sents.en: This week the ministry said it is changing that plan.
sents.ko: 이번 주 국방부는 그 계획을 고치고 있다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: A new version would build a joint academy in Daejeon.
sents.ko: 새 안은 대전에 통합 사관학교를 세우는 것이에요.

sents.en: The Navy and Air Force academies would stay in Jinhae and Cheongju.
sents.ko: 해군과 공군 사관학교는 진해와 청주에 남아요.

sents.en: The Army academy would move to the Chungcheong region.
sents.ko: 육군 사관학교는 충청 지역으로 옮겨 가요.

paragraphs.en: The first plan aimed to help the three services work together and make cadet education more efficient. But alumni, opposition lawmakers and people in Jinhae and Cheongju pushed back. Spokesperson Chung Binna said the change is part of a process to win more public acceptance. Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul told parliament that the revision is neither a retreat nor a compromise.
paragraphs.ko: 원래 계획은 군 사이의 협력을 높이고 생도 교육을 효율적으로 하려는 것이었어요. 하지만 동문, 야당 의원, 진해와 청주 주민이 반발했어요. 국방부 대변인은 이번 수정이 국민의 공감을 얻는 과정이라고 말했어요. 강신철 국방부 장관은 국회에서 후퇴도 타협도 아니라고 했어요.

sents.en: The first plan aimed to help the three services work together and make cadet education more efficient.
sents.ko: 처음 계획은 세 군이 함께 일하게 돕고 생도 교육을 더 효율적으로 하려는 것이었어요.

sents.en: But alumni, opposition lawmakers and people in Jinhae and Cheongju pushed back.
sents.ko: 하지만 동문, 야당 의원, 진해와 청주 주민이 반발했어요.

sents.en: Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul told parliament that the revision is neither a retreat nor a compromise.

Yonhap also said cadets and alumni fear a merger could weaken the special identity and skills of each service. According to Yonhap, the new plan would cost about 1.5 trillion won, down from 2.7 trillion won.
paragraphs.ko: 연합뉴스는 대변인의 말이 반대 의견을 받아들일 여지가 있다는 뜻으로 보인다고 전했어요. 생도와 동문은 합치면 각 군의 고유한 정체성과 전문성이 약해질까 걱정한다고 해요. 연합뉴스에 따르면 수정안의 비용은 약 1조 5천억 원으로, 원래 추정치 2조 7천억 원보다 줄었어요.

paragraphs.en: The ministry is also asking the cadets themselves. An online survey runs from Friday through Tuesday and covers 2,350 cadets from all four class years. sents.en: Questions ask how to improve facilities, teachers and courses while keeping each branch's traditions.
sents.ko: 질문은 각 군의 전통을 지키면서 시설, 교수진, 교육과정을 어떻게 개선할지 묻는 내용이에요.

paragraphs.en: The ministry will explain the final plan once it is ready. Chung said opinions will keep being collected while the law and its enforcement decree are written. The real budget will be set after a preliminary study.

pro.en: The defense ministry, which had set out to fold the Army, Air Force and Navy academies into one institution, said this week that it is reworking that blueprint. Under the new version, a joint academy would be established in Daejeon, the Navy and Air Force academies would stay in Jinhae and Cheongju, and the Army academy would be transferred to the Chungcheong region.

The original scheme was intended to strengthen collaboration among the services and make officer training more efficient, yet it provoked resistance from alumni, opposition lawmakers and residents of Jinhae and Cheongju. Ministry spokesperson Chung Binna characterized the revision as part of a push for wider public acceptance, while Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul told parliament that it amounted to neither a retreat nor a compromise.

Yonhap observed that Chung's remarks seemed to indicate a willingness to make adjustments, and it added that cadets and alumni are concerned that a merger might dilute the distinct identity and specialized capabilities of each service. By Yonhap's account, the revised plan is estimated to cost roughly 1.5 trillion won, compared with an original estimate of 2.7 trillion won.

The ministry has also sought out the cadets themselves through an online survey that runs from Friday through Tuesday and targets 2,350 cadets across all four class years, with about 143 naval cadets away on rotational training excluded. Respondents are asked how facilities, faculty and curricula could be improved without sacrificing each branch's traditions, and whether they would be interested in a graduate school program. Because cadets are of college age, the dispute also bears on how such a school ought to be run.

The ministry has pledged to explain the plan once it is settled, and Chung said that feedback would continue to be gathered while the enabling law and its enforcement decree are prepared. The actual budget will be fixed after a preliminary study.

pro.en: Disney+'s fantasy romance "The Remarried Empress," adapted from a web novel of the same name, premiered on Nov. 3, with Shin Min-a headlining as Empress Navier. Ju Ji-hoon, Lee Se-young and Lee Jong-suk round out the principal cast.

The narrative follows Sovieshu, the emperor, as he grows close to Rashta, a former runaway slave, while Navier declines to compete for his affection and instead charts her own course. She is aided by Heinrey, an enigmatic prince capable of transforming into a bird named Queen.

At a press conference, Shin said she aimed to portray Navier as both an unwavering empress and a deeply human woman. Director Cho Su-won said he sought a middle register between the brighter webtoon and the more serious novel, condensing the source material into 10 episodes. Ju said he was braced for criticism of his villainous role.
The property, which also spawned a webtoon that had logged nearly 3 billion views as of July, carries considerable fan expectations, making a live-action adaptation a demanding undertaking.

Newly released stills show Sovieshu publicly challenging Heinrey to a duel, while Rashta's claim to be Heinrey's secret pen pal threatens further turmoil in the imperial court. Episodes 5 and 6 were released on Nov. 11.

pro.en: Samsung Lions star Koo Ja-wook has retained a US-based agent in pursuit of a major league contract this offseason, according to a report Friday. Mark Feinsand of MLB.com said the 33-year-old outfielder had signed with Jaron Long of Mako Corp. as he seeks a jump from the Korea Baseball Organization to Major League Baseball.

Koo is coming off a Korean Series MVP award after helping the Lions capture their first KBO championship in 12 years. He went 10-for-20 with a home run and six RBIs as the Lions defeated the KT Wiz in five games, despite playing through lingering effects of a hamstring injury.

During the regular season, Koo claimed his first career batting title at .371 and led the league with a .458 on-base percentage. Across 1,466 career games, he owns a lifetime average of .322, along with 201 home runs and 984 RBIs.

Koo is a free agent this winter after his five-year contract with the club expired. At a press conference following the title-clinching win, he appealed to any major league club to contact him and insisted he was serious about taking on the challenge in the United States. Long, 35, is a former minor league pitcher who previously worked for Boras Corporation.

pro.en: The transportation ministry said Thursday it had approved Jin Air's planned merger with Air Seoul and Air Busan, clearing the way for an integrated low-cost carrier to begin operating in March.

The approval comes as Korean Air, Jin Air's parent and the nation's largest airline, prepares to complete its merger with Asiana Airlines on Dec. 17, while Air Seoul and Air Busan are Asiana subsidiaries.

The three carriers intend to convene extraordinary shareholder meetings next month to endorse the deal, and the combined entity, with a fleet of 58 aircraft, would be the country's largest low-cost airline; the Fair Trade Commission has also signed off on the merger.

As part of the integration, Jin Air has submitted a plan to develop Gimhae International Airport in Busan into a second hub, aiming to lift international routes there from 28 to 33 and weekly flights from 281 to 339.
The shareholder votes in December and the launch of the integrated carrier in March are the milestones to watch.

views.view: Yonhap reported that the ministry and the Fair Trade Commission both approved the merger, and that a larger Busan hub is planned.

pro.en: Netflix announced Thursday that Kim Go-eun and Gang Dong-won have been cast in an upcoming historical romance drama, "The Twilight Between Us," marking the first collaboration between the two actors. The series blends romance and action with fantasy elements.

The drama centers on a man and a woman from two families locked in a bitter feud for 100 years, who are forced to wed by royal decree. Gang portrays Mu-yeong, an illegitimate son of the Kang family known for his martial prowess, while Kim plays Su-ryeon, the only daughter of the Han family, who is compelled to marry him after failing to become crown princess.

The series was written by Park Ji-eun, whose credits include "Queen of Tears" in 2024 and "Crash Landing on You." issues.title: Asian Cup Football Tournament Is Postponed to Late 2027 After Attacks on Saudi Arabia
issues.gist: Asia's top football tournament was moved from January 2027 to December 2027. The organizers said attacks on host Saudi Arabia made the original plan too hard.
issues.gistKo: 아시아 최고의 축구 대회인 아시안컵이 2027년 1월에서 12월로 미뤄졌어요. 개최국 사우디아라비아에 대한 공격 때문에 원래 일정을 지키기 어렵다고 주최 측이 밝혔어요.
issues.easyKo: 사우디에서 열릴 예정이던 아시안컵이 약 1년 가까이 늦춰졌어요. 중동의 전쟁 상황 때문에 선수와 팬의 안전을 먼저 생각한 결정이에요.

paragraphs.en: The Asian Football Confederation announced on Tuesday that the Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia will be postponed. The tournament was set for Jan. 7 to Feb. 5, 2027. It will now run from Dec. 23, 2027, to Jan. 21, 2028. The new dates will be presented to FIFA for approval.

sents.en: The tournament was set for Jan. 7 to Feb. 5, 2027.
sents.ko: 대회는 원래 2027년 1월 7일부터 2월 5일까지 열릴 예정이었어요.

sents.en: It will now run from Dec. 23, 2027, to Jan. 21, 2028.

sents.ko: 새 일정은 FIFA의 승인을 받기 위해 제출될 거예요.

paragraphs.en: The reason is a wave of attacks on Saudi Arabia by Houthi rebels from Yemen. The AFC spoke of 'substantial logistical complexities and travel disruptions' in the region. The Houthis have targeted Saudi infrastructure, including airports. The tournament was to feature 24 teams in eight venues across Riyadh, Jeddah and Khobar.
paragraphs.ko: 이유는 예멘 후티 반군이 사우디아라비아를 공격하고 있기 때문이에요. AFC는 물류가 크게 복잡해지고 이동이 막힌다고 설명했어요. 후티는 공항을 포함한 사우디 기반 시설을 노려 왔어요. 대회는 24개 팀이 리야드, 제다, 호바르의 경기장 8곳에서 치를 예정이었어요.

sents.en: The reason is a wave of attacks on Saudi Arabia by Houthi rebels from Yemen.
sents.ko: 이유는 예멘 후티 반군이 사우디아라비아를 연달아 공격하고 있기 때문이에요.

sents.en: The AFC spoke of 'substantial logistical complexities and travel disruptions' in the region.
sents.ko: AFC는 지역에서 '상당한 물류 복잡성과 이동 차질'이 있다고 말했어요.

sents.en: The Houthis have targeted Saudi infrastructure, including airports.
sents.ko: 후티는 공항을 포함한 사우디 기반 시설을 노려 왔어요.

paragraphs.en: Several other sports events in the region have also been delayed or canceled. They include a Formula One race, the men's and women's tennis finals, and the 2027 Dakar Rally. Some federations had pressed the AFC to delay, and South Korea's players led the way. Lee Keun-ho, head of the Korea Professional Footballers Association, said no tournament is worth more than the lives of players and fans. The Saudi organizing chief, Yasser al-Misehal, said the country is 'fully ready' for the new dates.
paragraphs.ko: 중동 분쟁 때문에 일정이 바뀐 스포츠 행사가 이미 여럿 있었어요. 포뮬러 원 경기, 테니스 결승, 2027년 다카르 랠리 등이에요. 한국 선수들이 앞장서서 연기를 요구했는데, 한국프로축구선수협회 이근호 회장은 어떤 대회의 가치도 선수와 팬의 생명보다 앞설 수 없다고 말했어요. 사우디 조직위 위원장은 사우디가 '완전히 준비돼 있다'고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: Several other sports events in the region have also been delayed or canceled.
sents.ko: 이 지역의 다른 스포츠 행사도 여러 개 미뤄지거나 취소됐어요.

sents.en: They include a Formula One race, the men's and women's tennis finals, and the 2027 Dakar Rally.
sents.ko: 포뮬러 원 경기, 남녀 테니스 결승, 2027년 다카르 랠리가 그런 예예요.

sents.en: Some federations had pressed the AFC to delay, and South Korea's players led the way.

sents.en: Lee Keun-ho, head of the Korea Professional Footballers Association, said no tournament is worth more than the lives of players and fans.
sents.ko: 한국프로축구선수협회 이근호 회장은 어떤 대회도 선수와 팬의 생명보다 값지지 않다고 말했어요.

sents.en: The Saudi organizing chief, Yasser al-Misehal, said the country is 'fully ready' for the new dates.
sents.ko: 사우디 조직위 위원장 야세르 알미세할은 새 일정에도 사우디가 '완전히 준비돼 있다'고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The delay also affects South Korea's national team. Caretaker coach Robert Moreno was appointed in September and signed through Nov. 27. The Korea Football Association plans to hold an election for its next president on Dec. 18. An official said the new president may need to pick the next coach, so Moreno may stay a little longer.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 대표팀에도 영향이 있어요. 로베르트 모레노 감독대행은 9월에 선임됐고 11월 27일까지 계약돼 있어요. 대한축구협회는 새 회장 선거를 12월 18일쯤으로 잡고 있어요. 협회 관계자는 새 회장이 감독을 뽑는 게 맞을 수 있고, 그동안 모레노를 더 맡길 수도 있다고 말했어요.

sents.en: The delay also affects South Korea's national team.
sents.ko: 연기는 한국 대표팀에도 영향을 줘요.

sents.en: Caretaker coach Robert Moreno was appointed in September and signed through Nov. 27.
sents.ko: 감독대행 로베르트 모레노는 9월에 선임됐고 11월 27일까지 계약했어요.

sents.en: The Korea Football Association plans to hold an election for its next president on Dec. 18.
sents.ko: 대한축구협회는 12월 18일에 다음 회장 선거를 치를 예정이에요.

sents.en: An official said the new president may need to pick the next coach, so Moreno may stay a little longer.
sents.ko: 한 관계자는 새 회장이 다음 감독을 뽑아야 할 수 있어서 모레노가 조금 더 맡을 수 있다고 말했어요.

pro.en: The Asian Football Confederation announced on Tuesday that it had postponed the Asian Cup, which was scheduled for Jan. 7 to Feb. 5, 2027, in Saudi Arabia, and that the tournament would instead be played from Dec. 23, 2027, to Jan. 21, 2028, subject to FIFA's approval.

The postponement followed a series of deadly attacks on the host nation by Yemen's Houthi rebels, who have struck Saudi infrastructure including airports. The AFC cited 'substantial logistical complexities and travel disruptions,' and the 24-team event had been planned for eight venues across Riyadh, Jeddah and Khobar.

The decision comes after a string of regional sporting events, including a Formula One race, the men's and women's tennis finals and the 2027 Dakar Rally, were delayed or canceled. Several federations, led by South Korea's players, had urged a delay, with Lee Keun-ho of the Korea Professional Footballers Association saying no tournament should take precedence over the lives of players and fans, while Saudi organizing chief Yasser al-Misehal insisted the kingdom was 'fully ready.'

The new schedule complicates matters for South Korea, whose caretaker coach, Robert Moreno, was appointed in September on a deal running through Nov. 27. With the Korea Football Association's presidential election tentatively set for Dec. 18, an official suggested the incoming president might choose the next coach, and that Moreno could be retained in the interim.

views.view: Yonhap says the delay makes the future of South Korea's coach unclear, since the football association has no president yet.
DW says the Asian Cup is the latest sports event hit by the conflict, and some federations had pushed for a delay.

pro.en: Personal data belonging to participants in a government-backed startup program has been leaked after a cyberattack on a company that supports the program, the startups ministry said Friday.

The artificial intelligence solutions company detected the hacking attack on Wednesday, the ministry said. The breach compromised the personal data of 20,028 people, including 818 participants in the startup support program. The exposed information includes the names, phone numbers and email addresses of service users.

The leak came only months after a similar hacking attack in June, in which the personal information of 5,000 participants in the program was leaked. In July, the ministry announced measures to bolster security for the program and prevent future attacks.
For students weighing a startup, the case raises questions about how their data is safeguarded when they apply to such programs. The ministry's response to this second leak will be closely watched.

views.view: The leak came months after a similar attack in June, even though the ministry had announced security measures in July.

sents.ko: 한국 학생들에게 이것은 한국 항공우주 기업이 해외에서 커지는 모습을 보여 줘요.

sents.en: Next, watch whether Indonesia actually buys the jet.
sents.ko: 다음으로는 인도네시아가 실제로 이 전투기를 사는지 지켜보면 돼요.

pro.en: South Korea's Korea Aerospace Industries (KAI) announced Friday that it intends to broaden its collaboration with Indonesian state-owned planemaker PT Dirgantara Indonesia (PTDI), a push that takes in manufacture of the KF-21 combat aircraft.

The arrangement took shape Wednesday in Jakarta, where the two firms put their names to three memorandums of understanding spanning the KF-21, flight simulators and commercial aircraft, timed to coincide with the 12th Korea-Indonesia Defense Industry Cooperation Committee meeting.

Under the KF-21 accord, the partners will study the possibility of building aircraft components on Indonesian soil, among them three categories of structural components, with PTDI joining the production process.

Jakarta has long maintained tight defense-industrial links with KAI, having bought the KT-1 basic trainer and the T-50 advanced trainer jets, and having joined the KF-21 programme as an international development partner. KAI has shipped 20 KT-1B trainers to Indonesia, agreed a deal to prolong their service life and delivered 22 T-50i jets.
Against that backdrop, KAI is hoping Indonesia will emerge as the first foreign buyer of the KF-21, South Korea's domestically developed supersonic fighter.

views.view: KAI says it signed three agreements with PTDI and hopes Indonesia will be the first overseas buyer of the KF-21.
The report lists Indonesia's past purchases of KAI trainers and says it joined KF-21 development as a partner.

issues.title: Korea to Let Card Users Turn Reward Points Into Regional Cash Vouchers
issues.gist: From May next year, Korean card users can turn unused reward points into regional cash vouchers. The government wants to boost spending in local shops.
issues.gistKo: 내년 5월부터 한국의 카드 이용자는 안 쓴 적립 포인트를 지역 상품권으로 바꿀 수 있어요. 정부는 동네 가게의 소비를 늘리려고 해요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 카드 포인트를 그냥 두지 말고 지역화폐로 바꿔 동네 가게에서 쓰게 하겠다는 정책이에요. 내년 5월부터 앱으로 바꿀 수 있고, 카드 포인트가 첫 대상이에요.

paragraphs.en: Credit card users in Korea will be able to turn unused reward points into regional cash vouchers. This will start in May next year, officials said on Friday. The goal is to boost spending and help local shops.
paragraphs.ko: 정부가 내년 5월부터 신용카드 포인트를 지역화폐로 바꿀 수 있게 한다고 밝혔어요. 소비를 늘리고 지역 경제를 살리려는 조치예요.

sents.en: Credit card users in Korea will be able to turn unused reward points into regional cash vouchers.

paragraphs.en: President Lee Jae Myung told officials in late June to let people use hidden or dormant points as local money. Several agencies then worked out the details, including the Financial Services Commission. Card points come first because they already have systems for turning them into cash. They add up to 2.1 trillion won.

sents.en: President Lee Jae Myung told officials in late June to let people use hidden or dormant points as local money.

sents.en: They add up to 2.1 trillion won.

pro.en: Credit card holders will be able to convert dormant reward points into regional cash vouchers starting in May next year, officials said Friday, as part of efforts to stimulate consumption and revive local economies.

The measure follows President Lee Jae Myung's instruction in late June to permit the conversion of hidden or dormant points into local currency, and the Financial Services Commission and other agencies have since drawn up the details. Card points will be eligible first because conversion systems already exist for them, and they total 2.1 trillion won.

Once the service begins in May, users can view their balances through an app and request conversion of any amount, with the local currency usable from the following day. Officials intend to extend the program to KTX rail miles and other points.

Government Policy Coordination Minister Lim Ki-keun said the government would continue discussions to ease the financial burden on households and channel money toward small business owners. Students holding unused card points may find it a simple way to put them to use, and the next development to watch is whether other points join the scheme.

issues.title: Former Presidential Security Official Oh Hyun-joo Named New Head of KOICA
issues.gist: South Korea named Oh Hyun-joo as the new head of KOICA, its agency for foreign aid. She was a senior official at the presidential National Security Office.

pro.en: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced Friday that Oh Hyun-joo, a former third deputy director of the presidential National Security Office, has been named to head the Korea International Cooperation Agency, known as KOICA. Oh is to formally assume the post on Monday. The agency is affiliated with the foreign ministry and oversees the country's official development assistance programs.

Oh began her diplomatic career in 1994 and went on to serve in development cooperation and multilateral diplomacy, among them as deputy chief of mission at South Korea's mission to the United Nations. She was named the country's first female ambassador to the Holy See in January 2023, and last June she took up the post of third deputy director of the National Security Office.

The ministry voiced the expectation that Oh will steer KOICA toward its aspiration of becoming a leading global development cooperation agency, while reinforcing its function as a consolidated platform for South Korea's grant aid programs. The KOICA president serves a three-year term, is chosen through open recruitment followed by screening by an executive recommendation committee, and may be reappointed for additional one-year terms.

For students interested in foreign aid or careers in international work, the appointment offers a view of who steers a major aid agency. Attention now turns to the goals Oh sets once she takes office on Monday.

views.view: Oh, a career diplomat, was named KOICA head, and the ministry said it expects her to raise KOICA's global role.
The report lists Oh's career and says the KOICA president serves three years and can be reappointed for one-year terms.

issues.title: U.S. House Passes Bill to Help Small Businesses Face Threats From Foreign Adversaries, Including North Korea

pro.en: Lawmakers in the U.S. House of Representatives on Wednesday approved the Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026, legislation designed to shield American small businesses from hostile foreign actors. The measure will next be taken up by the Senate.

It would direct the Small Business Administration to equip small firms with guidance on recognizing and countering such menaces, which range from the theft of trade secrets and cyber intrusions to knock-off merchandise and exploitative investment schemes.

During Wednesday's floor debate, Rep. Roger Williams, a Texas Republican, contended that China, Russia and North Korea are seeking to weaken the nation's economic and security standing. He noted that small businesses tend to be the most exposed because they lack the means and the know-how to detect these dangers.

From October 2027, the agency would have to revisit its instructional materials every year. It would also have to alert the appropriate congressional committees to particular conduct that poses grave risks to American economic or national security interests.

pro.en: Woori Financial Group's nominating committee approved a one-year extension for Woori Bank chief executive Jung Jin-wan on Friday, keeping him in the post through Dec. 31, 2027, subject to a shareholder vote later this month.

Under the group's policy, a newly installed bank head receives an initial two-year mandate that may be lengthened by a year after a performance review; Jung took office in November 2024, and the committee credited him with a stronger capital ratio, a return to loan growth and quarterly net profit above 1 trillion won ($750 million) at the end of September.

The committee also highlighted the lender's platform ventures, notably Samsung Wallet Money, which drew more than 3 million subscribers within a year, and said he could convert the bank's bolstered capital into growth and narrow the earnings gap with competitors.

Jung becomes the first among the chiefs of the five largest commercial banks, KB Kookmin, Shinhan, Hana, Woori and NH NongHyup, to secure reappointment, while the other four, whose terms also lapse at year's end, are expected to settle their leadership choices shortly.

pro.en: President Lee Jae Myung said Friday that hostile mergers and acquisitions are the most important mechanism for normalizing the South Korean stock market, speaking during a two-and-a-half-hour capital market policy meeting at the Korea Exchange in Seoul.

Lee argued that Korean equities suffer from abnormal undervaluation and asked officials to identify measures that could lift them. When shares are priced far below their worth, he said, an outsider could acquire the company and either resell it at a normal price or operate it directly. Hostile bids are legal in South Korea, but concentrated ownership makes them difficult without the consent of controlling shareholders, and he called for a comprehensive review of the mechanisms that block such deals.

Lee also questioned whether companies that function effectively as private businesses should remain listed, citing firms in which controlling shareholders hold more than half, and in some cases 70 percent to 80 percent, of outstanding shares. He said he was unsure whether a 50 percent threshold was appropriate and asked officials to examine the question further.

The meeting also took up proposed mandatory tender offer rules, which would oblige an acquirer to offer to buy shares from minority shareholders when corporate control changes hands. The ruling and opposition parties have agreed to introduce the system by revising the Capital Markets Act this session, but domestic and foreign asset managers have opposed a proposal requiring a purchase of at least 50 percent plus one share, arguing it would not give minority holders an equal chance to sell.

Lee put the question of full versus partial offers to an impromptu show-of-hands vote, then described it as a policy judgment balancing the interests of controlling and minority shareholders, with neither approach absolutely right. He nonetheless said he leaned toward expanding M&A even at the risk of criticism, while cautioning against excessive activity.

sents.ko: 가족은 강원도 인제에서 충청남도 청양까지 차로 갔어요.

sents.en: The trip was well over 200 kilometers.
sents.ko: 그 거리는 200킬로미터를 훨씬 넘었어요.

paragraphs.en: Drivers on the road rolled down their windows and gave thumbs-up. Some made finger hearts, and some honked to say congratulations. In a thank-you post on Wednesday, the father thanked people for their warm words. He said some people might think the sign was too much, and he said sorry if the car caused any trouble. Online, people called the idea creative and cute, and the story spread widely.
paragraphs.ko: 가는 길에 다른 운전자들이 창문을 내리고 엄지를 들거나 손가락 하트를 만들고 경적을 울려 축하했어요. 아버지는 수요일에 감사 글을 올려 따뜻한 말에 고마워했고, 과하다고 느낀 사람이 있을까 봐 사과했어요. 댓글에서는 창의적이고 귀엽다는 반응이 나왔어요.

sents.en: Some made finger hearts, and some honked to say congratulations.

paragraphs.en: In Korea, military service is a big step in life for many young men. The end of it can be a happy day for a whole family. This story shows how a small sign can share that joy.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 남성에게 군 복무는 큰 일이라서 끝나는 날이 가족에게도 기쁜 날이에요. 이 이야기는 그 마음이 이런 작은 방법으로 드러날 수 있음을 보여 줘요.

sents.en: In Korea, military service is a big step in life for many young men.
sents.ko: 한국에서 군 복무는 많은 젊은 남성에게 인생의 큰 단계예요.

sents.en: The end of it can be a happy day for a whole family.
sents.ko: 그것이 끝나는 날은 온 가족에게 기쁜 날일 수 있어요.

sents.en: This story shows how a small sign can share that joy.
sents.ko: 이 이야기는 작은 현수막으로도 그 기쁨을 나눌 수 있음을 보여 줘요.

pro.en: A banner reading that the owner's son had just completed his military service, a playful twist on the familiar "Baby on board" car sticker, appeared in a photo posted on the online forum Bobaedream.

The father said he wanted to mark the end of his son's 18-month compulsory military service, and the family drove from Inje, Gangwon Province, to Cheongyang, South Chungcheong Province, a journey of well over 200 kilometers.

Along the route, drivers rolled down their windows to flash thumbs-up and finger hearts or honk their horns, and in a post on Wednesday the father thanked well-wishers, acknowledged that some might find the gesture excessive and apologized for any inconvenience, while commenters praised it as creative and adorable.
Military service is a defining milestone for many young Korean men, and the episode suggests that its completion is a moment families are keen to celebrate publicly.

views.view: The Korea Herald tells the story in a warm, light way: strangers cheered, and commenters called the sign creative and cute.

issues.title: Samsung Biologics labor dispute grows as union chair is sent to prosecutors
issues.gist: Workers at Samsung Biologics are in a partial strike, and the union wants to join a bigger labor group. Police also sent the union chair to prosecutors over a claimed leak of company secrets.
issues.gistKo: 삼성바이오로직스 노조가 부분 파업 중이고 상급 단체 가입도 추진해요. 한편 경찰은 노조 위원장을 영업비밀 유출 혐의로 검찰에 넘겼어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 삼성바이오로직스 노사 갈등이 더 커지고 있어요. 노조는 일부 업무에서 파업하며 힘을 키우려 하고, 경찰은 위원장이 회사 비밀을 유출했다고 봐요. 위원장은 부인해요.

paragraphs.en: Workers at Samsung Biologics are in a labor dispute with the company. About 500 union members have joined a partial strike that began on Nov. 6. It is set to continue until Nov. 27. The company says the strike has not hurt production so far.
paragraphs.ko: 삼성바이오로직스 노조가 11월 6일부터 두 번째 부분 파업을 하고 있어요. 약 500명이 참여하고, 11월 27일까지 이어질 예정이에요. 회사는 지금까지 생산에 차질이 없다고 말해요.

sents.en: Workers at Samsung Biologics are in a labor dispute with the company.
sents.ko: 삼성바이오로직스 직원들이 회사와 노동 분쟁 중이에요.

sents.en: About 500 union members have joined a partial strike that began on Nov. 6.
sents.ko: 약 500명의 노조원이 11월 6일 시작된 부분 파업에 참여하고 있어요.

sents.en: It is set to continue until Nov. 27.
sents.ko: 파업은 11월 27일까지 이어질 예정이에요.

sents.en: The company says the strike has not hurt production so far.
sents.ko: 회사는 지금까지 파업이 생산에 피해를 주지 않았다고 말해요.

paragraphs.en: A court ruling limited strikes in key factory work, and nine kinds of work are now covered. So the union is striking in support jobs, such as quality testing and logistics. The union also holds an online vote from Friday to Tuesday on joining the Federation of Korean Trade Unions. That group is the country's second-largest umbrella labor organization.
paragraphs.ko: 법원이 핵심 생산 업무에 대한 쟁의행위를 제한해서, 파업이 막힌 업무가 아홉 가지로 늘었어요. 그래서 노조는 품질 검사, 물류 같은 지원 업무 중심으로 파업해요. 노조는 상급 단체인 한국노총에 가입할지 온라인 투표도 해요.

sents.en: A court ruling limited strikes in key factory work, and nine kinds of work are now covered.
sents.ko: 법원 결정이 핵심 공장 업무의 파업을 제한했고, 아홉 가지 업무가 해당돼요.

sents.en: So the union is striking in support jobs, such as quality testing and logistics.
sents.ko: 그래서 노조는 품질 검사와 물류 같은 지원 업무에서 파업해요.

sents.en: The union also holds an online vote from Friday to Tuesday on joining the Federation of Korean Trade Unions.
sents.ko: 노조는 금요일부터 화요일까지 한국노총 가입을 묻는 온라인 투표도 해요.

sents.en: That group is the country's second-largest umbrella labor organization.
sents.ko: 한국노총은 나라에서 두 번째로 큰 노동 단체예요.

paragraphs.en: On Nov. 13, the Incheon police sent two people, including union chair Park Jae-sung, to prosecutors. They are accused of getting into an internal system and taking tax invoice records from the public relations department. Police say the records were put in a union newsletter and shared outside. Park has fully denied the trade secret leak.
paragraphs.ko: 11월 13일 인천경찰청은 노조 위원장 박재성 씨 등 2명을 검찰에 넘겼어요. 회사 내부 시스템에 접근해 홍보 부서의 세금계산서 기록을 얻고 노조 소식지에 실어 밖으로 퍼뜨렸다는 혐의예요. 박 위원장은 영업비밀 유출 혐의를 모두 부인해요.

sents.en: On Nov. 13, the Incheon police sent two people, including union chair Park Jae-sung, to prosecutors.
sents.ko: 11월 13일 인천경찰청은 노조 위원장 박재성 씨를 포함한 2명을 검찰에 넘겼어요.

sents.en: They are accused of getting into an internal system and taking tax invoice records from the public relations department.
sents.ko: 이들은 내부 시스템에 들어가 홍보 부서의 세금계산서 기록을 가져간 혐의를 받아요.

sents.en: Park has fully denied the trade secret leak.

paragraphs.en: The company stresses the need to protect trade secrets. The union is expected to say its actions were legitimate. Talks between management and the union are set to restart on Tuesday. Prosecutors are now deciding whether to indict.
paragraphs.ko: 회사는 영업비밀 보호를 강조하고, 노조는 정당한 활동이었다고 맞설 것으로 보여요. 협상은 화요일에 다시 시작돼요. 검찰은 기소할지 검토 중이에요.

sents.en: The company stresses the need to protect trade secrets.
sents.ko: 회사는 영업비밀 보호를 강조해요.

sents.en: The union is expected to say its actions were legitimate.
sents.ko: 노조는 자신들의 행동이 정당했다고 주장할 것으로 보여요.

sents.en: Talks between management and the union are set to restart on Tuesday.
sents.ko: 노사 협상은 화요일에 다시 시작될 예정이에요.

sents.en: Prosecutors are now deciding whether to indict.
sents.ko: 검찰은 이제 기소할지 판단하고 있어요.

pro.en: A second partial strike at Samsung Biologics, which began on Nov. 6 and involves about 500 union members, is scheduled to run through Nov. 27, although the company said the walkout had not disrupted production so far.

Since a court ruling broadened the scope of work covered by strike injunctions to nine categories across key manufacturing operations, the union has concentrated its action on support and indirect production functions. It is also holding an online vote on affiliating with the Federation of Korean Trade Unions, the country's second-largest umbrella labor organization.

On Nov. 13, the Incheon Metropolitan Police Agency referred two people, among them union chair Park Jae-sung, to prosecutors over allegations that they gained entry to an internal system, obtained tax invoice records held by the public relations department and circulated them outside the company through a union newsletter. Park has fully denied the allegation.

Management is stressing the need to safeguard trade secrets, whereas the union is expected to counter that its conduct was legitimate. Collective bargaining is due to resume on Tuesday, and prosecutors are still weighing whether to bring charges.

views.view: The union's move to join FKTU is another step up in the dispute, while the company says production has not been hurt.
Police say the evidence backs the leak claim, but Park denies it, and the company and union are expected to clash over it.

issues.title: Samsung Lions Beat the KT Wiz 12-1 in Game 5 to Win the Korean Series
issues.gist: The Samsung Lions won the Korean Series four games to one. They beat the KT Wiz 12-1 in the deciding Game 5.
issues.gistKo: 삼성 라이온즈가 한국시리즈에서 4승 1패로 우승했어요. 마지막 5차전에서 KT 위즈를 12대 1로 이겼어요.

But their hitters scored just seven runs in the three losses in Daegu. The team batted only .207 in the series. The pitchers had a 6.00 ERA and gave 24 walks in 45 innings.

paragraphs.en: Logan Allen, the Game 4 starter, got only three outs and gave up six runs in the first inning. In Game 5, Ko Young-pyo gave up eight runs, six of them unearned, in 1 1/3 innings. Manager Lee Kang-chul said his pinch-hitting calls came a little late. He also said the 12-inning loss in Game 2 hurt the team for the rest of the series.

They had also ended the regular season on a 10-game winning streak. Still, their bats and pitchers failed them in the final series. Next year will show how the Wiz bounce back.

pro.en: The Samsung Lions clinched the Korean Series by routing the KT Wiz 12-1 in the decisive Game 5 on Sunday, Nov. 8, in Daegu, taking the best-of-seven championship four games to one after the Wiz had opened with an 8-7 home win and then dropped four straight.

The Wiz had posted the Korea Baseball Organization's best regular-season record at 90-49-5, finishing eight games clear of the Lions and earning a bye past the early postseason rounds, yet their hitters managed only seven runs in the three losses in Daegu and batted just .207 for the series, while the pitching staff produced a 6.00 ERA and issued 24 walks over 45 innings.

Game 4 starter Logan Allen recorded only three outs and surrendered six runs in the first inning, and in Game 5 Ko Young-pyo conceded eight runs, six of them unearned, across 1 1/3 innings, while manager Lee Kang-chul acknowledged that his pinch-hitting decisions had come a little late and said the 12-inning defeat in Game 2 weighed on the club for the rest of the series.

The Wiz were the first club to reach 90 victories since 2018 and had closed the regular season on a 10-game winning streak, yet they could not convert that success into a championship, and attention will turn to how they rebound next year.

issues.title: KOSPI Falls Two Days in a Row as the Won Weakens Against the Dollar
issues.gist: South Korea's main stock index, the KOSPI, fell on Thursday and again on Friday. The won also weakened against the US dollar on Friday.
issues.gistKo: 한국의 대표 주가 지수인 코스피가 목요일과 금요일 이틀 연속 내렸어요. 금요일에는 원화도 미국 달러에 대해 약해졌어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's main stock market index fell on Thursday. The benchmark index is called the KOSPI. It dropped 32.63 points, or 0.61 percent, to close at 5,342.73. The tech-heavy KOSDAQ lost 8.57 points, or 1.22 percent, to close at 696.53.
paragraphs.ko: 목요일 코스피는 32.63포인트, 0.61% 내려 5,342.73에 마감했어요. 기술주가 많은 코스닥은 8.57포인트, 1.22% 내려 696.53에 마감했어요.

sents.en: South Korea's main stock market index fell on Thursday.

paragraphs.en: On Friday, the stock market fell again. The KOSPI lost 52.2 points, or 0.98 percent, and closed at 5,290.53. That is a two-day drop of about 85 points. The KOSDAQ moved the other way and gained 3.13 points, or 0.45 percent, to close at 699.66.
paragraphs.ko: 금요일에도 코스피는 52.2포인트, 0.98% 내려 5,290.53에 마감했어요. 이틀 동안 약 85포인트 내린 셈이에요. 코스닥은 반대로 3.13포인트, 0.45% 올라 699.66에 마감했어요.

sents.en: On Friday, the stock market fell again.

paragraphs.ko: 원화도 움직였어요. 목요일에는 달러에 대해 2.9원 강해져 1,330.7원이 됐고, 금요일에는 6원 약해져 오후 3시 30분 기준 1,336.7원이 됐어요. 보도에는 이런 움직임의 이유가 나오지 않아요.

sents.en: The won also moved against the US dollar.
sents.ko: 원화도 미국 달러에 대해 움직였어요.

sents.en: On Thursday, it strengthened by 2.9 won and traded at 1,330.7 won per dollar.

pro.en: South Korea's benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index, or KOSPI, slipped 32.63 points, or 0.61 percent, to end Thursday's session at 5,342.73. The technology-heavy KOSDAQ shed 8.57 points, or 1.22 percent, to settle at 696.53.

The KOSPI extended its losses on Friday, retreating 52.2 points, or 0.98 percent, to close at 5,290.53, a two-day decline of roughly 85 points. The KOSDAQ, by contrast, edged up 3.13 points, or 0.45 percent, to finish at 699.66.

On the currency front, the won firmed by 2.9 against the greenback on Thursday to trade at 1,330.7 per dollar. It then softened by 6 on Friday to 1,336.7 per dollar as of 3:30 p.m., and the reports offered no explanation for the swings.
A softer won raises the local cost of dollar-denominated purchases, from online subscriptions to overseas study expenses. The coming sessions will show whether the KOSPI's slide persists or reverses.

issues.title: KT Wiz Hold Off Samsung Lions 8-7 in Game 1 of the Korean Series as Closer Park Yeong-hyun Saves the Night
issues.gist: The KT Wiz won Game 1 of the Korean Series 8-7 over the Samsung Lions. They almost lost an 8-0 lead before closer Park Yeong-hyun ended the game.
issues.gistKo: KT 위즈가 한국시리즈 1차전에서 삼성 라이온즈를 8-7로 이겼어요. 8-0이던 점수가 거의 따라잡혔지만 마무리 박영현 선수가 경기를 끝냈어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 크게 앞서던 KT가 방심하는 사이 삼성이 바짝 따라왔지만, 마무리 투수가 마지막 이닝을 삼진 세 개로 막아서 겨우 이긴 경기예요.

paragraphs.en: The KT Wiz beat the Samsung Lions 8-7 in Game 1 of the Korean Series on Nov. 3. The game was played in Suwon, just south of Seoul. The Wiz led 8-0 after six innings. Then the Lions scored five runs in the seventh inning and one more in the eighth.

sents.en: The KT Wiz beat the Samsung Lions 8-7 in Game 1 of the Korean Series on Nov. 3.
sents.ko: KT 위즈는 11월 3일 한국시리즈 1차전에서 삼성 라이온즈를 8-7으로 이겼어요.

paragraphs.en: Park Yeong-hyun, the Wiz closer, came in with one out and the bases loaded in the top of the eighth. The Wiz were ahead 8-6 at that point. Ryu Ji-hyuk hit a fly ball to left field, but the runner at third was Koo Ja-wook, who was playing through a hamstring injury. Koo could not sprint home, so the run did not score. Park then threw a wild pitch over his catcher's head, and Koo scored the Lions' seventh run.

pro.en: The KT Wiz edged the Samsung Lions 8-7 in Game 1 of the Korean Series in Suwon on Nov. 3, squandering most of an 8-0 lead after six innings as the Lions scored five runs in the seventh and another in the eighth.

Closer Park Yeong-hyun entered in the top of the eighth with one out, the bases loaded and the Wiz clinging to an 8-6 advantage. Ryu Ji-hyuk lifted a fly ball to left, but the runner on third, Koo Ja-wook, who was playing through a hamstring injury, could not sprint home, and Park then uncorked a wild pitch over his catcher's head that let Koo score the Lions' seventh run.

Park recorded the last out of the eighth and returned for the ninth, where the 23-year-old struck out all three batters swinging at sliders. He said catcher Han Seung-taek had repeatedly called for the pitch and that he trusted his battery mate.

Having finished atop the regular season standings, the Wiz went directly to the Korean Series and had not played since Oct. 12. Park, who had been criticized over the years for struggling after long layoffs, said with a smile that the outing should put that notion to rest.

The best-of-seven series opens with two games in Suwon, shifts to Daegu for Games 3 through 5 and returns to Suwon for the finale. Slugger Ahn Hyun-min said he hopes the Wiz can finish off the series in Daegu rather than face the pressure of a Game 6 at home.

pro.en: Director Lee Chang-dong pledged on Nov. 6 to give his all in the Academy Awards race with "Possible Love," South Korea's official Oscar submission, which earned the Silver Lion Grand Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival and marks his first feature in eight years since "Burning" in 2018.

Lee cautioned that "Parasite" had created an optical illusion and that comparable success may not readily recur for Korean cinema. Barriers remain high for Korean and other Asian films, he said, even as the Academy moves toward greater inclusiveness, but he felt obliged to keep open the possibility of recognition for the actors and crew who gave the project everything.

The film, featuring Jeon Do-yeon, Sul Kyung-gu, Zo In-sung and Cho Yeo-jeong, probes love and economic disparity through the intertwined lives of two couples. After a limited theatrical run in South Korea in September, it reached Netflix on Nov. 6, and Lee urged viewers to resist the impulse to pause or fast-forward.

Lee's 28-minute short "Heartbeat," produced for a World Health Organization project on depression, joined Netflix on Nov. 2. Streaming gives Korean films a direct route to global audiences, and how they respond will be the next thing to watch.

pro.en: Soompi reported that aespa's music video for "LEMONADE" surpassed 100 million views on YouTube on November 13, at approximately 12:21 p.m. KST. It is the group's twelfth music video to reach that milestone, and Soompi, a K-pop news site, reported the news on the same day. The list of earlier videos also includes "Savage," "Girls," "Spicy," "Drama," "Armageddon" and "Dirty Work."

The group originally released the "LEMONADE" video on May 29 at 1 p.m. KST, so it took just over five months and 14 days to reach the mark. Earlier videos to do so include "Whiplash," "Black Mamba," "Next Level" and "Supernova."

For fans, a 100 million tally signals sustained viewership of a group's releases, and K-pop remains a staple of campus conversation, while a video this popular can help a group reach fans in many countries. Attention now turns to which aespa video will cross the threshold next.

views.view: The report celebrates the video as another 100-million-view hit in aespa's growing collection.

pro.en: Korea Electric Power Corp. (KEPCO) disclosed that its net income for the third quarter shrank 78 percent from a year earlier, falling to 835.89 billion won from 3.79 trillion won.

A spokesperson for the utility pointed to softer electricity sales and a continued climb in international thermal coal prices, noting that fuel expenses at its generation subsidiaries together exceeded 2.2 trillion won.

Operating income dropped 70.9 percent to 1.64 trillion won, and revenue slipped 2.6 percent to 26.85 trillion won, while cumulative net income for the first nine months declined 50.4 percent to 3.63 trillion won.
The company has been run under an emergency management regime since Russia's Feb. 2022 invasion of Ukraine, a period in which pricier fuel inflated its borrowings and interest obligations.
KEPCO said it would keep a careful eye on erratic energy markets while continuing to trim expenses and prioritize profitability to shore up its finances.

views.view: KEPCO's profit fell on higher fuel costs and lower sales, and the company will keep its emergency cost-cutting system.

pro.en: Yun Yuh-soon, a former LG Group executive, has published a new book titled 'The Time to Awaken Half,' a direct translation of its Korean title, arguing that organizations that overlook women squander half of their available talent.
Yun, 71, joined LG Academy in 1995 at the age of 40 and became LG Group's first female executive in 2000. She subsequently led LG Arts Center and now works as a leadership coach and lecturer.

In the book, Yun notes that at many organizations female staff make up 20 to 30 percent of the workforce but often hold only 3 to 5 percent of executive seats. Data from the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, published Sept. 29, put the proportion of women among executives at 3,240 companies at 7.4 percent last year, and The Economist's 2026 Glass Ceiling Index ranked South Korea 28th of 29 countries.

Yun rejects the idea that women should shoulder the burden of change alone, urging male leaders to reconsider how they identify and develop talent. The book examines unconscious bias, promotion systems and informal networks, and draws on interviews with more than 20 executives and employees. In her view, equal opportunity is a rational business decision rather than a favor.

Yun contends that the issue has become pressing as firms grapple with artificial intelligence, a shrinking birthrate and tougher competition for talent, since Korean women, though well educated, thin out sharply at each rung of the corporate hierarchy.

pro.en: SpaceX announced on Thursday that it plans to invest $74 billion in new data center campuses in Arizona and Texas as Elon Musk's rocket and artificial intelligence company keeps pouring money into the global AI race, in what would rank among the largest data center projects in the United States.

In Texas, the company intends to put $24 billion into a campus on 444 acres of company-owned land near its Starbase rocket site in the Rio Grande Valley, generating its own power rather than drawing on the public grid. In Cochise County, Arizona, it plans a $50 billion campus that it says will create 5,500 construction jobs and 1,000 permanent positions, though that project still requires county approval.

SpaceX, which went public this year in the largest initial public offering on record, has swiftly built a business leasing computing power to other AI companies, and said in October that its AI operations accounted for more than half of revenue. Anthropic has committed to paying up to $120.5 billion through 2029, while Google is paying $920 million a month.

The buildout has proved expensive: capital expenditures climbed to $19.6 billion in the third quarter, nearly triple the previous year's level, and Musk said in October that the company had closed $40 billion in debt financing to fund the chips its data centers require. Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and other technology giants have likewise spent tens of billions of dollars on their own campuses.

views.view: The plan is among the biggest US data center projects, and it is costly, while the Arizona part still needs county approval.
