pro.en: EXO members Kai and Sehun, performing as the new unit EXO-KASE, announced on Nov. 13 the dates and cities of their first fan concert tour, titled SILENT CITY, which opens in January and will take the duo to eight locations across Asia.

The tour begins with concerts on Jan. 9 and 10 at Korea University's Hwajeong Tiger Dome in Seoul before moving on to Kuala Lumpur, Macau, Jakarta, Tokyo, Bangkok, Taipei and Manila, where Philippine media report the show will be held at the Araneta Coliseum.

Tickets for the Seoul dates will be sold through Melon Ticket, with a domestic presale for EXO-L, the official fan club, on Nov. 23 and a global presale on Nov. 24, followed by general sales on Nov. 25.
Ahead of the tour, EXO-KASE will put out its debut mini album, Waking Up The City, on Dec. 1, and fans hoping to attend are advised to keep the sales schedule in mind.

pro.en: Pope Leo arrived in Peru on Wednesday, returning to a country where he served as a priest for roughly two decades, rose to bishop and became a citizen. ABC News described the trip as his first return to the nation where he had worked as a missionary and bishop.

According to the New York Times, Catholicism is still the leading religious force in Peru and the wider region, yet the church is contending with two serious pressures in Latin America: rising secularization and rivalry from other Christian denominations. Evangelical congregations have grown substantially, and their members say they find a closer personal bond with God and a livelier, more contemporary style of worship there.

At Agua Viva, a Pentecostal megachurch in Lima, a rock band performed while strobe lights swept over the audience. Scarlet Reyes, 21, a former Catholic who began attending two years ago, said that many places talk about God, whereas at Agua Viva people are taught how to know him.

The papal visit highlights how the Catholic Church is seeking to retain its flock in a shifting Latin America. Observers will watch what message the pontiff delivers on these challenges during his trip.

pro.en: Cade Cunningham poured in 52 points as the Detroit Pistons outlasted the Washington Wizards 144-140 in double overtime on Thursday, becoming the first player in NBA history to combine 50 points and 10 assists without committing a turnover, while Ausar Thompson contributed a triple-double of 17 points, 11 assists and 11 rebounds.

The contest featured 20 lead changes, with Detroit opening a double-digit cushion early in the second half before Washington whittled it away, and after Cunningham was fouled with less than two seconds remaining and the Pistons clinging to a 119-118 advantage, he sank both free throws, only for Trae Young to answer with a shot at the buzzer that forced overtime.

Washington surged to a 128-121 lead in the first extra period, but Cunningham drained a three-pointer with 30 seconds left to level the score, a replay ruled that Duncan Robinson's toe was on the line, and Young then set up AJ Dybantsa for a pull-up jumper that forced a second overtime, in which Cunningham's fadeaway gave Detroit a four-point edge with 25 seconds left and Young missed two three-point attempts.

Three Wizards starters, Young, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr, each scored 30 or more points, but Washington still suffered its sixth consecutive defeat, and Cunningham said after two overtimes the outcome came down to who wanted it more, leaving the Wizards to find a way to end their skid.

pro.en: Roughly 80 world leaders are due in the Turkish coastal city of Antalya this week for the UN climate summit, COP31, the first to be shared between a host, Turkey, and a negotiating chair, Australia. Delegates will weigh a global electrification target designed to hasten the shift from coal, oil and gas toward clean power.

The author concedes that the annual talks are beset by challenges: the United States has withdrawn completely, countries are not on track to hold warming to agreed levels, and decisions require consensus among more than 190 nations, which tends to yield lowest-common-denominator outcomes.

Even so, the author contends that a long view reveals progress. Before the Paris Agreement the world was heading for roughly 4°C of warming this century, whereas the 2025 round of national targets suggests warming could be limited to 2.6°C, and more than 130 countries have adopted long-term net-zero goals.

Collectively, the author argues, COP commitments serve as a market signal, with global clean energy investment reaching A$3.2 trillion this year, twice that going to coal, oil and gas. Letters to The Guardian, by contrast, say climate action must be rethought beyond the COP process.

For Korean students, the negotiations bear on energy policy, employment and the rules facing exporters. The next development to watch is whether delegates in Antalya reach agreement on the electrification target.

pro.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he believed a win-win deal could be struck with the European Union, one that could be more like the Brexit that people thought they were voting for in 2016. Speaking after meeting European leaders in Dublin on Thursday, he predicted the negotiations could go down to the wire.

London and Brussels hope to sign new agreements on food, energy and youth mobility at a summit on Nov. 20. The two sides have already agreed a draft deal on removing post-Brexit checks on food and agricultural exports, and the government claims the package will eventually deliver annual economic benefits worth 5.1 billion pounds.

University tuition fees for European students remain a sticking point. The EU has said the food deal may not enter into force without an agreement under which European students pay domestic rates, while Burnham said requests were coming from the European side and that the UK was tabling its own.

The push has divided opinion. The Conservatives accuse Labour of dragging the country into the EU through the back door, and party leader Kemi Badenoch has said aligning with EU rules would take the UK backwards. Former prime minister David Cameron argued Britain's problems had nothing to do with Brexit, a claim Burnham rejected, while EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said she would like to see Britain back in the bloc but warned the talks would not be easy.

The summit could also affect Korean students weighing study in Britain, since tuition rules and exchange schemes are on the table. Attention now turns to whether the agreements are signed on Nov. 20 and how the fee dispute is settled.

pro.en: Indonesia's 39-year-old vice president, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, has stepped down after months of scrutiny over his education credentials. He met President Prabowo Subianto on Tuesday and offered to resign, and by Wednesday evening he had left office, according to a senior aide.

Last month, Indonesia's constitutional court concluded that the record offered no convincing evidence he had ever completed high school, which Indonesian law makes a prerequisite for those seeking office, yet it held that it lacked the power to annul the 2024 election result. Stirred by the ruling, parliament stepped up its drive to impeach him.

The Guardian argued that the affair goes beyond Gibran's schooling. The eldest son of former president Joko Widodo, widely known as Jokowi, he was steered onto Prabowo's presidential ticket, and analysts later credited a Jokowi effect for part of Prabowo's 2024 victory. One analyst quoted by The New York Times said the relationship had clearly fractured and that Prabowo was seeking to demonstrate he had emerged from Jokowi's shadow.

The upheaval comes in the world's third-largest democracy and Southeast Asia's largest economy. The Guardian reported that Prabowo's approval rating slid to 44.5% in October from 81.2% a year earlier, as he contends with street protests, economic turbulence and discontent over flagship policies such as his free meals program.

The People's Consultative Assembly is due to select a new vice president within 60 days from two names put forward by the president. One political analyst cautioned against reading the resignation as a one-off.

pro.en: Experts cautioned in a report published Nov. 10 that the pharmaceutical industry's rush into GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, including Ozempic and Mounjaro, could divert drugmakers' attention away from diabetes treatments. The warning came from Jay Iyer, chief executive of the Access to Medicine Foundation.

While the obesity drugs have spread rapidly, many people in poorer countries still struggle to obtain basic diabetes care, and insulin remains critical for those with type 1 diabetes. The Harvard Gazette has reported that nearly one in eight U.S. adults used such drugs last year.

Companies can command far higher prices for weight-loss injections than for insulin, an imbalance that experts cite as a reason attention could drift away from the older medicine. Iyer cautioned that Sanofi, Eli Lilly or Novo Nordisk could exit the insulin market, and Novo Nordisk has announced plans to phase out some older diabetes products, including insulin pens.
The episode illustrates how profit can shape which treatments receive priority, and the question now is whether manufacturers will keep insulin supplies steady.

pro.en: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said Thursday that it had arrested and deported more people than at any point in the agency's 23-year history, according to figures for the fiscal year that ended Sept. 30.

The agency said it removed 483,200 people, a 9% increase from the prior record of 442,640 a year earlier and 78% above the 271,480 recorded in 2024, the final year of President Joe Biden's term. Arrests totaled 474,850, roughly double the 239,890 of the previous year and more than four times the 113,430 in 2024. ICE also reported more than 48,000 arrests in September, which ended a two-month streak of records that peaked at 50,925 in August.

ABC News reported that Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin credited President Donald Trump's leadership for the results. ICE had not published such precise tallies since Trump's return to the White House, including for 2025. Unlike earlier administrations, the press release did not break down how many of those detained had criminal histories.

The data underscore the intensity of U.S. immigration enforcement, a topic likely to stay prominent for South Korean students who hope to study or work in the United States. The next question is whether ICE will later release figures on criminal histories.

views.view: ICE reports record arrests and deportations, but its release does not show how many people had criminal histories.

issues.title: Study: Stopping Statins After 70 May Be Safe in the Short Term, but Risk Rose Over Four Years
issues.gist: A large study asked if adults over 70 can stop taking statins to prevent a first heart attack or stroke. After two years the risk did not rise much, but over four years it was higher.
issues.gistKo: 70세 이상이 첫 심장마비나 뇌졸중을 막으려고 먹는 스타틴을 끊어도 되는지 본 큰 연구예요. 2년 뒤에는 위험이 크게 늘지 않았지만 4년까지 보면 더 높았어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 스타틴을 끊어도 단기적으로는 큰 문제가 없어 보이지만 길게 보면 위험이 조금 더 높아질 수 있어요. 그래서 의사와 함께 정하라는 결론이에요.

paragraphs.en: A large new study looked at older adults who take statins. Statins are drugs that lower bad cholesterol. The people in the study were 70 or older and had never had a heart attack or stroke. Researchers wanted to know if it is safe for them to stop.
paragraphs.ko: 스타틴은 나쁜 콜레스테롤을 낮추는 약이에요. 한 큰 연구는 심장마비나 뇌졸중을 겪은 적 없는 70세 이상이 이 약을 안전하게 끊을 수 있는지 살폈어요.

sents.en: A large new study looked at older adults who take statins.
sents.ko: 새 대규모 연구는 스타틴을 먹는 고령자를 살폈어요.

sents.ko: 스타틴은 나쁜 콜레스테롤을 낮추는 약이에요.

sents.en: The people in the study were 70 or older and had never had a heart attack or stroke.
sents.ko: 연구 대상은 70세 이상이고 심장마비나 뇌졸중을 겪은 적이 없었어요.

sents.en: Researchers wanted to know if it is safe for them to stop.
sents.ko: 연구진은 이들이 약을 끊어도 안전한지 알고 싶었어요.

paragraphs.en: The trial had 1,880 adults with an average age of 77. In all, 938 people stopped statins, and 942 kept taking them. Everyone also had at least two long-term health problems. The work took place at 24 medical centers in Switzerland, France, and the Netherlands.
paragraphs.ko: 연구에는 평균 나이 77세인 1,880명이 참여했어요. 938명은 약을 끊고 942명은 계속 먹었어요. 스위스, 프랑스, 네덜란드의 24개 의료 기관에서 진행했어요.

sents.ko: 시험에는 평균 나이 77세인 1,880명이 참여했어요.

sents.en: In all, 938 people stopped statins, and 942 kept taking them.
sents.ko: 938명은 스타틴을 끊고 942명은 계속 먹었어요.

sents.en: Everyone also had at least two long-term health problems.
sents.ko: 모두 만성 질환이 적어도 두 가지 있었어요.

sents.en: The work took place at 24 medical centers in Switzerland, France, and the Netherlands.
sents.ko: 스위스, 프랑스, 네덜란드의 24개 의료 기관에서 진행했어요.

paragraphs.en: After about two years, stopping statins did not cause a significant rise in heart attacks, strokes, or deaths. However, there was about one extra event for every 40 people who stopped. Over up to four years, 12.7% of those who stopped had a heart attack, stroke, or death. Among those who kept taking statins, the share was 9.2%.

sents.en: Over up to four years, 12.7% of those who stopped had a heart attack, stroke, or death.

sents.en: She says the small extra risk means doctors cannot give one rule for everyone.
sents.ko: 작은 추가 위험 때문에 모두에게 같은 규칙을 줄 수 없다고 해요.

sents.en: She says patients and doctors should decide together.
sents.ko: 환자와 의사가 함께 정해야 한다고 해요.

sents.en: The results are preliminary and were shared at the American Heart Association's Scientific Sessions 2026 in Chicago.
sents.ko: 결과는 예비 단계이며 시카고의 2026년 미국심장협회 학술대회에서 발표되었어요.

pro.en: A large new study examined adults aged 70 and older who take statins, cholesterol-lowering drugs, to prevent a first cardiovascular event, asking whether they can safely discontinue the medication. All participants had never suffered a heart attack or stroke.

The trial enrolled 1,880 adults with an average age of 77, of whom 938 were assigned to stop statins and 942 to continue. Every participant had at least two chronic conditions, and the research was conducted at 24 medical centers in Switzerland, France and the Netherlands.

After roughly two years, those who stopped did not experience a statistically significant increase in heart attacks, strokes or deaths, though the data showed about one additional event for every 40 people who discontinued. Over follow-up lasting up to four years, 12.7% of those who stopped had a heart attack, stroke or death, compared with 9.2% of those who stayed on the drugs.

Rita F. Redberg of the University of California, San Francisco, said the modest added risk precludes a blanket recommendation and called for shared decision-making between patient and doctor. The preliminary findings were presented at the American Heart Association's Scientific Sessions 2026 in Chicago.

views.view: The report says stopping statins may be an option for many people over 70, but the longer follow-up shows more risk, so it should be a personal decision with a doctor.

issues.title: Study Finds AI Citations Often Do Not Show Where Answers Really Come From
issues.gist: A new paper tests AI systems that cite sources. It finds that some claims come from the model's memory, not from the documents it cites.
issues.gistKo: 새 논문이 출처를 인용하는 AI 시스템을 시험했어요. 일부 주장은 인용한 문서가 아니라 모델의 기억에서 나온다는 결과예요.
issues.easyKo: AI가 답에 출처를 붙여도 정말 그 출처를 읽고 쓴 건지는 별개예요. 이 논문은 출처와 상관없이 기억으로 답하고 맞는 출처를 끼워 맞추는 경우가 있다고 말해요.

paragraphs.en: A new research paper asks whether AI answers really use the sources they cite. Retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, lets an AI system look up documents and attach citations to its claims. The authors say these citations often misstate where a claim really came from.
paragraphs.ko: AI 답변이 인용한 출처를 정말 쓰는지 묻는 새 논문이 나왔어요.

sents.en: A new research paper asks whether AI answers really use the sources they cite.
sents.ko: 새 연구 논문은 AI 답변이 인용한 출처를 정말 쓰는지 물어요.

sents.en: Retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, lets an AI system look up documents and attach citations to its claims.
sents.ko: 검색 증강 생성(RAG)은 AI가 문서를 찾아보고 주장에 인용을 붙이게 하는 방식이에요.

sents.en: The authors say these citations often misstate where a claim really came from.
sents.ko: 저자들은 이런 인용이 주장의 진짜 출처를 잘못 나타낼 때가 많다고 해요.

paragraphs.en: To test this, the team replaced one fact in the retrieved text with a false version and asked the model again. If the answer did not change, the claim probably came from the model's own memory. Across five sizes of one model family and a second family, 1.2% to 15.7% of citable claims came from memory, not the retrieved text. Within a family, the rate rose with model size.
paragraphs.ko: 모델 기억에서 나온 주장이 1.2%에서 15.7%였고, 모델이 클수록 비율이 높아졌어요.

sents.en: To test this, the team replaced one fact in the retrieved text with a false version and asked the model again.
sents.ko: 이를 시험하려고 연구팀은 찾은 글의 사실 하나를 거짓 버전으로 바꾸고 모델에게 다시 물었어요.

sents.en: If the answer did not change, the claim probably came from the model's own memory.
sents.ko: 답이 바뀌지 않으면 그 주장은 모델 자신의 기억에서 나왔을 가능성이 커요.

sents.en: Across five sizes of one model family and a second family, 1.2% to 15.7% of citable claims came from memory, not the retrieved text.
sents.ko: 한 모델 계열의 다섯 크기와 다른 계열을 시험했더니 인용할 만한 주장의 1.2%에서 15.7%가 찾은 글이 아니라 기억에서 나왔어요.

sents.en: Within a family, the rate rose with model size.
sents.ko: 같은 계열에서는 모델이 클수록 그 비율이 높아졌어요.

paragraphs.en: The usual way to check citations, natural language inference, did no better than chance. The authors say the cause is structural: a model answering from memory picks a citation that agrees with its answer. They compared ten methods, and the contrast between the model's answers with and without context worked best.
paragraphs.ko: 보통의 인용 확인법은 우연 수준이었고 원인은 구조적이라고 해요.

sents.en: The usual way to check citations, natural language inference, did no better than chance.
sents.ko: 인용을 확인하는 보통 방법인 자연어 추론은 우연보다 나을 것이 없었어요.

sents.en: The authors say the cause is structural: a model answering from memory picks a citation that agrees with its answer.
sents.ko: 저자들은 구조적 원인이라고 해요. 기억으로 답하는 모델이 자기 답과 맞는 인용을 고르기 때문이에요.

sents.en: They compared ten methods, and the contrast between the model's answers with and without context worked best.
sents.ko: 열 가지 방법을 비교했는데, 문맥이 있을 때와 없을 때 모델 답의 차이가 가장 잘 구분했어요.

paragraphs.en: Even so, the resulting detector is not accurate enough to act on. It measures what the model knew, not what it used, and separating the two is still an open problem. For students, the lesson is to check a source yourself before trusting an AI citation.
paragraphs.ko: 탐지기는 아직 쓰기엔 부정확해서, 학생은 출처를 직접 확인해야 해요.

sents.en: Even so, the resulting detector is not accurate enough to act on.
sents.ko: 그래도 이렇게 만든 탐지기는 실제로 쓰기엔 충분히 정확하지 않아요.

sents.en: It measures what the model knew, not what it used, and separating the two is still an open problem.
sents.ko: 모델이 무엇을 알았는지는 재지만 무엇을 썼는지는 재지 못해서, 둘을 가르는 일은 아직 풀리지 않은 문제예요.

sents.en: For students, the lesson is to check a source yourself before trusting an AI citation.
sents.ko: 학생에게 주는 교훈은 AI의 인용을 믿기 전에 출처를 직접 확인하라는 거예요.

pro.en: A new arXiv paper examines whether AI answers genuinely draw on the sources they cite. Retrieval-augmented generation systems attach citations to their claims, but the authors contend that these citations frequently misstate provenance and that standard verification cannot detect the problem.

The researchers substituted a false variant for a fact in the retrieved passages and queried the model again. Across five sizes of one model family and a second comparator family, between 1.2% and 15.7% of citable claims derived from parametric memory rather than retrieved context, and the rate rose with model size within a family.

Natural language inference, the standard verification approach, produced results indistinguishable from chance. The authors attribute this to a structural cause, namely that a model answering from memory selects a citation consistent with its output, and they found that the contrast between the model's distribution with and without context best separated provenance among ten methods.

Even so, the resulting detector remains too inaccurate to act on, since it captures what the model knew rather than what it used. Distinguishing the two is, in the authors' words, still the open problem, so readers should verify cited sources themselves.

issues.title: ECB's Philip Lane Explains How Central Bank Messages Move Markets but Often Miss Households
issues.gist: In a London speech, Philip Lane of the ECB said central bank words move financial markets. But most households do not follow them, so clear explanations matter when inflation is high and people pay more attention.
issues.gistKo: 유럽중앙은행의 필립 레인이 런던 연설에서 중앙은행의 말이 금융시장을 움직인다고 했어요. 하지만 대부분의 가계는 그 말을 잘 안 들어서, 물가가 높을 때는 분명한 설명이 중요하다고 했어요.
issues.easyKo: 쉽게 말하면, 중앙은행이 금리만 정하는 게 아니라 '말'로도 경제를 움직인다는 이야기예요. 시장은 잘 듣지만 보통 사람은 잘 안 들어서, 쉽고 일관되게 전하는 게 중요해요.

paragraphs.en: Philip R. Lane of the European Central Bank gave a speech in London on November 10. He spoke at a conference about the Bank of England and its watchers. He said that what a central bank says shapes more than its rate decisions. It also affects financial markets, household choices and trust in policy. He added that these views are his own, not those of the full Governing Council.
paragraphs.ko: 유럽중앙은행의 필립 R. 레인이 11월 10일 런던에서 열린 영란은행 관련 학회에서 기조연설을 했어요. 그는 중앙은행의 소통이 금리 결정만큼이나 금융 여건과 가계, 기업의 결정, 정책의 신뢰에 영향을 준다고 말했어요. 이 글은 레인 개인의 생각이고 정책위원회 전체의 입장이 아니라고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: Philip R. Lane of the European Central Bank gave a speech in London on November 10.
sents.ko: 유럽중앙은행의 필립 R. 레인이 11월 10일 런던에서 연설했어요.

sents.en: He spoke at a conference about the Bank of England and its watchers.
sents.ko: 그는 영란은행과 시장 관찰자들을 다룬 학회에서 말했어요.

sents.en: He said that what a central bank says shapes more than its rate decisions.
sents.ko: 그는 중앙은행의 말이 금리 결정 이상의 영향을 준다고 했어요.

sents.en: It also affects financial markets, household choices and trust in policy.
sents.ko: 그 말은 금융시장, 가계의 선택, 정책에 대한 신뢰에도 영향을 줘요.

sents.en: He added that these views are his own, not those of the full Governing Council.
sents.ko: 그는 이것이 정책위원회 전체가 아니라 자신의 견해라고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: Lane reviewed new research on central bank communication. Tools that use large language models found that the ECB sounds tougher when it raises rates. The tone becomes softer when it cuts them. Messages between meetings also move market interest rates. At longer maturities, their combined effect can match that of policy announcements.
paragraphs.ko: 레인은 최근 연구를 소개했어요. AI 도구로 ECB 글의 어조를 재 보니, 금리를 올릴 때는 강경하고 내릴 때는 온건해졌어요. 회의 사이의 발언도 시장 금리를 움직이고, 길게 보면 정책 발표만큼 큰 효과를 낼 수도 있어요.

sents.en: Lane reviewed new research on central bank communication.
sents.ko: 레인은 중앙은행 소통에 관한 새 연구를 살펴봤어요.

sents.en: Tools that use large language models found that the ECB sounds tougher when it raises rates.
sents.ko: 대규모 언어모델을 쓰는 도구는 ECB가 금리를 올릴 때 더 강경하게 들린다는 것을 찾았어요.

sents.en: The tone becomes softer when it cuts them.
sents.ko: 금리를 내릴 때는 어조가 부드러워져요.

sents.en: Messages between meetings also move market interest rates.
sents.ko: 회의 사이의 메시지도 시장 금리를 움직여요.

sents.en: At longer maturities, their combined effect can match that of policy announcements.
sents.ko: 만기가 긴 쪽에서는 그 효과를 합치면 정책 발표와 맞먹을 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: But households behave differently from markets. Most households do not follow central bank news. After the 2021 review, the new 2% target reached only about one in ten consumers. People pay more attention when inflation is high. Consumers mainly link monetary policy to the cost of borrowing.
paragraphs.ko: 하지만 가계는 다르다고 했어요. 대부분의 가계는 중앙은행 소식을 따라가지 않아요. 2021년 전략 검토 뒤 새 2% 물가 목표를 안 소비자는 열 명 가운데 한 명꼴에 그쳤다고 해요. 사람들은 물가가 높을 때 더 관심을 갖고, 통화정책을 주로 대출 이자와 연결해서 생각해요.

sents.en: But households behave differently from markets.
sents.ko: 하지만 가계는 시장과 다르게 움직여요.

sents.en: Most households do not follow central bank news.
sents.ko: 대부분의 가계는 중앙은행 소식을 따라가지 않아요.

sents.en: After the 2021 review, the new 2% target reached only about one in ten consumers.
sents.ko: 2021년 검토 뒤 새 2% 목표는 소비자 열 명 중 한 명꼴에게만 닿았어요.

sents.en: People pay more attention when inflation is high.
sents.ko: 사람들은 물가가 높을 때 더 관심을 가져요.

sents.en: Consumers mainly link monetary policy to the cost of borrowing.
sents.ko: 소비자는 통화정책을 주로 대출 비용과 연결해요.

paragraphs.en: Lane also looked back at the ECB's own history. After the 2012 pledge to do whatever it takes, the bank began forward guidance on rates in July 2013. In March 2023 it moved to guidance based on data, decided meeting by meeting. In July 2025, risks to the inflation outlook were added to that approach. He said this approach works better when rates are away from the lower bound. He said clear and relevant explanations matter when inflation is high, because people then pay more attention.
paragraphs.ko: 레인은 ECB가 걸어온 길도 짚었어요. 2012년 '무엇이든 하겠다'는 약속 뒤, 2013년 7월에 금리 전망 안내를 시작했어요. 2023년 3월에는 경제 지표에 따라 회의마다 정하는 방식으로 바꿨고, 2025년 7월에는 물가 위험 요인을 그 틀에 더했어요. 그는 이 방식이 금리 하한 근처가 아닐 때 더 잘 맞는다고 봤어요. 그는 물가가 높아 사람들이 더 주목할 때 분명하고 관련 있는 설명이 중요하다고 했어요.

sents.en: Lane also looked back at the ECB's own history.
sents.ko: 레인은 ECB의 역사도 돌아봤어요.

sents.en: After the 2012 pledge to do whatever it takes, the bank began forward guidance on rates in July 2013.
sents.ko: 2012년 무엇이든 하겠다는 약속 뒤, ECB는 2013년 7월 금리 전망 안내를 시작했어요.

sents.en: In March 2023 it moved to guidance based on data, decided meeting by meeting.
sents.ko: 2023년 3월에는 데이터에 따라 회의마다 정하는 안내로 바꿨어요.

sents.en: In July 2025, risks to the inflation outlook were added to that approach.
sents.ko: 2025년 7월에는 물가 전망의 위험 요인이 그 방식에 더해졌어요.

sents.en: He said this approach works better when rates are away from the lower bound.
sents.ko: 그는 금리가 하한에서 떨어져 있을 때 이 방식이 더 잘 맞는다고 했어요.

sents.en: He said clear and relevant explanations matter when inflation is high, because people then pay more attention.
sents.ko: 그는 물가가 높으면 사람들이 더 주목하기 때문에 그때 분명하고 관련 있는 설명이 중요하다고 했어요.

pro.en: Philip R. Lane of the European Central Bank delivered a keynote in London on Nov. 10 at a conference on the Bank of England and its watchers, arguing that central bank communication shapes financial conditions, household and corporate decisions and the credibility of policy, while stressing that the views were his own rather than those of the Governing Council.

Drawing on recent research, he noted that text-analysis tools built on large language models show the ECB's tone turning more hawkish during tightening and more dovish during easing, and that communication between meetings moves market rates, with its cumulative effect at longer maturities able to rival that of formal policy announcements.

Households, however, are far less attentive: most do not follow central bank communication, only about one in ten consumers had absorbed the new 2% target after the 2021 review, attention rises when inflation is elevated, and consumers tend to associate monetary policy chiefly with borrowing costs.

Lane traced the ECB's evolution from the 2012 pledge to do whatever it takes through the start of forward guidance on rates in July 2013 and the shift in March 2023 to data-dependent, meeting-by-meeting guidance, to which risks to the inflation outlook were added in July 2025, and he concluded that such framework guidance works better away from the lower bound and that clear, relevant explanation matters when inflation is high and public attention is greater.

issues.title: ECB Survey: Forecasters Raise 2026 Euro Area Inflation to 3.0% and Growth to 1.0%
issues.gist: The European Central Bank asked professional forecasters about the euro area economy. They now expect 3.0% inflation and 1.0% growth in 2026, both higher than before.
issues.gistKo: 유럽중앙은행이 전문가들에게 유로 지역 경제 전망을 물었어요. 이들은 2026년 물가 상승률을 3.0%, 성장률을 1.0%로 보며, 둘 다 지난번보다 높아졌어요.

pro.en: The European Central Bank released the results of its Survey of Professional Forecasters for the fourth quarter of 2026 on Oct. 30, showing respondents expect headline inflation, as measured by the HICP, of 3.0% in 2026, 2.6% in 2027 and 2.0% in 2028. Those figures were revised up by 0.3 and 0.4 percentage points for 2026 and 2027, respectively, from the previous round.
Respondents projected real GDP growth of 1.0% in 2026 and 1.3% in both 2027 and 2028, with the 2026 estimate raised by 0.4 percentage points and the 2027 figure by 0.1 point.

In a special question, forecasters indicated that additional effects of the energy price shock stemming from the war in the Middle East are mainly expected in 2027, while second-round effects should remain limited.

The balance of risks for inflation was tilted to the upside for 2026 through 2028, whereas risks to growth were skewed somewhat to the downside at all horizons. Unemployment expectations edged up to 6.4% for 2026 before drifting down to 6.1% over the longer term.

The findings offer a gauge of the euro area outlook that is relevant to Korean exporters and to students tracking European prices, and attention now turns to the central bank's next policy decisions and the next survey round.

views.view: The ECB reports that forecasters see inflation risks tilted up and growth risks tilted down, with limited second-round effects from the energy shock.

pro.en: Major League Baseball's free-agent period has opened with attention fixed on Tarik Skubal, a two-time Cy Young Award winner whom ESPN ranks as the winter's top available player. Skubal was dealt from the Detroit Tigers to the Los Angeles Dodgers at this year's trade deadline.

The sport's collective bargaining agreement expires on Dec. 1, after which players cannot sign until a new deal is struck, and many in baseball expect Skubal to finalize a contract before that deadline.

A source confirmed to ESPN that Skubal is scheduled to meet the New York Mets in California next week. ESPN describes the Mets as a club with a pressing need for front-line starting pitching and an owner, Steve Cohen, prepared to spend, while the Dodgers remain a logical destination. The Chicago Cubs, San Diego Padres and St. Louis Cardinals are among other clubs ESPN has identified as possible fits.

In an ESPN survey of industry insiders, the average projected contract for Skubal was eight years and $355 million, or an average annual value of $44.6 million, and most panelists predicted that a deal would be completed before Dec. 1.

Baseball's offseason is widely followed in South Korea, and the contest for the market's premier pitcher offers an easy entry point. The Mets meeting and the Dec. 1 expiration are the next developments to watch.

views.view: ESPN says the Mets look like a strong fit, and the Dodgers, Cubs, Padres and Cardinals are also possible.
